sharcidejin: m.dh Samaynta sharci la sameeyo. sharcin m.f.dh eeg sharci.
sharciyee: f.g2 (-yeeyay, -yaysay) Wax ku dhaqmiddiisa sharci ka dhigid. m.f.dh, sharciyayn.
sharciyeed: m.l 1. (qaan.) Waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu sifeeyo waxyaabaha la xiriira sharciga, aqoonta sharciga, ama isticmaalada sharciga. 2. (qaan.) Ficil ama xaalad sharciyeysan uu sharcigu oggolaaday ama ansixiyey.
shardi: m.l (shuruud, m.l) (xisaab) Hawraar ama weedh M oo lo baahanyahay in ay run noqoto si hawrar kale N ay u noqoto run. Haddii M ay tahay xaalad lagama maarmaan ah, markaa N ma noqon karto run M la'aanteed. Haddii M ay tahay xaalad kaafi ah markaa; markasta oo ay M noqoto run Nna waa run. Dhanka kale run ma noqon karto. Tusaale ahaan, haddii afar geesle uu noqon karo laydi waa in uu raaliggeliyaa xaaladaha lagama marmaanka ah in laba ka mid ah dhinacyada afar geesluhu ay yihiin barbaro, haseyeeshe, kani ma aha xaalad kaafiya ah, xaaladaha kaafiga ah ee afar geesle in uu yahay qardhaas waa in ay dhammaan dhinacyada afar geesluhu yihiin 5 cm., haseyeeshe kani ama xalaad lagama maarmaan ah. in laydi uu yahay labajibbaarane waa in uu raaliggeliyaa xaalad dhererka dhinacyadiisa in ay isle'egyihiin. Sida kale haddi M ay tahay xaalad lagama maarmaan ee N -> M, haddii M ay tahay xaalad kaafi ah markaa M -> N. Haddii M ay tahay xaalad lagama maarmaan ah iyo xaalad kaafi ah ee N markaa M <-> N.
shareer: m.l (-rro, m.dh) 1. Wax, wax kale lagu qariyo. 2. Sh. ah: meel hawd ah oo dhir badan oo aan la dhex mari karin. 3. Wax dheer sida buuraha, geedaha, dhismooyinka iyo wixi lamida meesha ugu sarraysa.
shareeran: f.mg4 (-rnaa, -rnayd) 1. Wax la qariyey ahaansho. 2. Wax la awday ahaansho. m.f.dh, shareernaan.
shareero: m.dh (-ooyin, ml.) (muus.) Qalab muusikada lagu tumo oo xargo yaryar oo silig ah leh oo sida kitaaradda looga dhawaajiyo.
shariif: m.l (-fyo, m.dh) 1. Qof ka soo jeeda faracii Faadumo Rasuul. 2. Qof suubban oo asluub wanaagsan.
shariig: m.l (-gyo, m.dh) Qof jiritaanka Alle cid kale la wadaajiyey.
shariikyeel: f.mg1 (-eelay, -eeshay) U sh.: Cibaadada Eebbe ruux kale la wadaajin. m.f.dh, shariikyeelid. la-mid: shariigyeel.
sharmuuto: m.dh (-ooyin/sharaamiid, m.l) Naag jirkeeda ka ganacsata; dhillo; qaxbo. m.l, sharaamiid.
sharoobo: m.dh Daawo qasan oo afka laga cabbo. la-mid: shiroobo.
sharrax: sharrax¹: m.l 1. Alaabooyin yaryar oo guryaha lagu qurxiyo. 2. (-xyo, m.dh) Qori lagu celiyo shukaanta markabka.
sharrax²: f.g1 (-xay, -xday) 1. Qalab meel ku qurxin. 2. Cid jago sare in loo doorto u magacaabid. m.f.dh, sharxid.
sharraxaad: m.dh Qurxinta meel lagu qurxiyo nalal, dhar, qalab iyo wixi lamida. la-mid: sharraxid.
sharraxan: f.mg4 (-xnaa, -xnayd) 1. Meel wax qalab lagu qurxiyey ahaansho. 2. Cid doorasho u magacaaban ahaansho. m.f.dh, sharraxnaan.
sharrib: f.g1 (-bay, -btay) 1. Wax qabashadooda isku dayid. 2. Wax tijaabin. m.f.dh, sharribid. la-mid: shirrab.
sharribaad: m.dh 1. Isku dayidda la isku dayo wax samayntooda. 2. Tijaabinta wax la tijaabiyo.
sharuur: m.l Iniino bun oo subag ama saliid lagu dubo oo korka la marsado lana cuno.
shataar: m.l.kh (-rro, m.dh) Sh. ah: qof arrimihiisa ganacsi fulin og oo xeelad iyo baraarugsanaan daran wax ku meel marsada. la-mid: shitaar.
shati: m.l (-iyo, m.dh) Dukumenti dawladeed oo sharciyeeya ganacsi.
shawaal: m.l/dh Bilaha dayaxa oo Muslinku tirsado tooda tobnaad oo u dhexeysa soonqaad iyo sidataal; soonfur.
shawr: shawr¹: m.l Kulan qarsoodi ah oo arrimo gaar ah looga wada hadlaayo. la-mid: showr.
shawr²: f.mg1 (-ray, -rtay) Kulan qarsoodi ah arrimo gaar ah uga wada hadlid. m.f.dh, shawrid. la-mid: showr.
shawri: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) Cid si qarsoodi ah wax ugu sheegid. m.f.dh, shawrin.
shax: m.dh 1. Cayaar dhulka lagu dhigto ama loox loo sameeyey korkiis oo laba qof lagu cayaaro. 2. Shilin yaryar oo aan ishu aad u qaban karin. 3. Jadwal.
shaxaad: shaxaad¹: m.l Si wax loo weyddiisto qof la yaqaan laguna kalsoonyahay.
shaxaad²: f.g1 (-day, -dday) Qof la yaqaan si kalsooni leh wax u weyddiisasho. m.f.dh, shaxaadid.
shaxam: m.l Sh. ah: qof aad u buuran.
shaxan-joomitiri: m.l (-nno ..., m.dh) (xisaab) Qaab ka samaysma isku xirka baro, xarriiqyo, xoodad ama dulo. Goobooyin, labajibbaaranayaal, saddex-xagallo waa shaxanno sallax ah. Kubbad, saddex jibbaarane, ahraam waa shaxanno adke ah.
shaxshax: m.dh.kh Sh. ah: wax nadaafad iyo muuqaal wanaagsan.
shay: m.l (xisaab) Shaygu waa wax leh qaab go'an oo aad taaban kartid, ama arki kartid oo aan nooleyn.
shaybaar: m.l (-rro, m.dh) Meel qalabaysan oo tijaabooyinka cilmiga lagu sameeyo.
shayddaan: m.l 1. Uun aan muuqan oo dadka xumaha ku boorriya. 2. (-nno/-mmo/-yaaddiin, mdh) Qof xumaha ka taliya. m.dh.w, shayaaddiin.
shed: shed¹: m.l Labanlaabidda shibbane carabi ah la labanlaabo.
shed²: f.g1 (-day, -dday) Shibbane carabi ah labanlaabid. m.f.dh, shedid.
shedan: f.mg4 (-dnaa, -dnayd) Xaraf carabi ah wax la labanlaabay ahaansho. m.f.dh, shednaan.
sheed: m.dh (-do, ml.) 1. (fk) Kor; mel dheer ama taag ah; buur. 2. Meel fog.
sheegato: m.dh Dad sheegta tol aysan ka dhalan ee xeer iyo dano kale ku raacay.
sheego: f.g3 (-gtay, -gatay) 1. Dacwad, arrin, qaan iyo wixi lamida jeedsasho. 2. Wax aan la ahayn ama la lahayn isku tilmaamid. m.f.dh, sheegasho.
sheekabaraley: m.dh.u Hadal ama sheeko aan runta ku fadhiyin.
sheekasheeko: m.dh Hadal aan murti badan lahayn oo waqtiga laysku dhaafiyo. la-mid: sheekosheeko.
sheekaxariiro: m.dh (-ooyin, m.l) Sheeko murti leh, la mala-awaalo oo soo gudbisa dhaqanka dadka; maantooley. la-mid: sheekaxariir.
sheekayso: f.mg3 (-stay, -satay) Cid sheeko la yeelasho. m.f.dh, sheekaysasho.
sheekee: f.mg2 (-keeyay, -kaysay) Qof, sheeko sheegid. m.f.dh, sheekayn.
sheeko: m.dh (-ooyin, m.l) 1. Hadal taxane ah oo dhacdo run ama been ah wax ka sheegaya. 2. Wax laysu sheego.
sheel: sheel¹: m.l 1. Meel wax lagu qarsado. 2. Xabsi.
sheel²: f.g1 (-eelay, -eeshay) Wax qarin. m.f.dh, sheelid.
sheellare: m.l (-rayaal, m.l/dh) Bir xalleefsan, shukaanta halkeeda hoose ku taal oo marka cagta lagu riixo uu kordho xawliga wareegga matoorku.
sheellaree: f.g2 (-reeyay, -raysay) Xawliga matoorka kordhin. m.f.dh, sheellarayn.
sheelo: m.dh Galka xaniinyaha oo weynaada xiidmaha oo soo gala awgeed.
sheelo-biyood: m.l (daaw.) Biyo ku ururka kiishka xiniinyaha.
sheex: sheex²: f.g/mg1 (-xay, -xday) 1. (f.g) Wax dhex taraarid. 2. (f.mg) Xishood dareemid. m.f.dh, sheexid.
shey: m.l 1. Geed weyn oo weligii cagaaran, dhala miro la cuno oo buuralayda ka baxa. 2. Wax; shay.
shib: m.dh 1. Hadal la'aan. 2. Sh. ah: degganaan aan hadal iyo shanqar midna jirin.
shibban: f.mg4 (-naa, -nayd) Wax aan hadlayn ahaansho. m.f.dh, shibbanaan.
shibbane: m.l (-nayaal, m.l/dh) (naxwe) Xaraf aan kaligii lagu dhawaaqi karin in shaqal lagu daro ma ahee; waxaa la maqli karaa kolka uu shaqal weheliyo. Tusaale: b(a), t(a), j(a) iyo wixi lamida.
shid: f.g1 (-day, -dday) 1. Dab iyo wixi lamida hurin. 2. Nal, raadiye iyo wixi lamida daarid. m.f.dh, shidid.
shidaal: m.l (-llo, m.dh) (kiim.) Walax la ogsidheeyo ama haddii kale lagu beddelo marraaq ama injiinka kulka si ay u sii dayso kulama tamar waxtar leh.
shidan: shidan¹: f.mg1 (-dmay, -dantay; -dmi) Dab, nal, raadiye iyo wixi lamida wax daarmay noqosho. m.f.dh, shidmid.
shidan²: f.mg4 (-dnaa, -dnayd) Nal, dab, raadiye iyo wixi lamida wax la shiday ahaansho. m.f.dh, shidnaan.
shiddee: f.g2 (-deeyay, -daysay) Cid shiddo ku abuurid. m.f.dh, shiddayn.
shiddo: m.dh (-ooyin, m.l) Dhibaato; rafaad. la-mid: shiidaad.
shidni: m.l Dhir udgoon iyo basbaas la isku shiiday, oo dhadhan wanaagsan oo cuntada lagu cuno leh.
shido: f.g3 1. Nal, raadiye iyo wixi lamida daarasho. 2. Dab iyo wixi lamida hursasho. m.f.dh, shidasho.
shifo: m.dh 1. Caafimaad wax lagu cuno ama lagu cabbo; fayoobi; ladnaan. 2. (e.d) Erey duco ah oo cuntada ama cabidda horteeda la yiraahdo, ama qof saxday lagu yiraahdo; salaama!
shig: f.mg1 (-gay, -gtay) Iin darteed hadal si dhib leh oo googo'an ugu dhawaaqid. m.f.dh, shigid.
shiica: m.dh (dii.) Dugsi ka mid ah dugsiyada fiqiga islaamka.
shiici: m.l.kh (dii.) Sh. ah: qof nidaamka shiicada raacsan.
shiid: shiid¹: m.l (-dad, m.l) 1. Dhar dun adag, midabyo badan oo dumarku qaato. 2. (-dad, ml.) Laba dhagax oo isku dul wareega oo badarka lagu ridqo. 3. Dhagax.
shiid²: f.g/mg1 (-day, -dday) 1. (f.g) Cid dhagax ku tuurid. 2. (f.g) Wax burburin. 3. (f.g) Laba dhagax oo is dulsaaran badar ku daqiijin. 4. (f.mg) Biyo hoos ugu degid. m.f.dh, shiidid.
shiidan: shiidan¹: f.mg1 (-dmay, -dantay; -dmi) Badar iyo wixi lamida wax la shiiday noqosho. m.f.dh, shiidmid.
shiidan²: f.mg4 (-dnaa, -dnayd) Wax la shiiday ahaansho. m.f.dh, shiidnaan.
shiifow: m.l Cudur lo'da ku dhaca oo indhaha iyo afka biyo ka keenaan; cundugul.
shiikh: m.l (-khyo, m.dh) 1. Nin diinta aad wax uga yaqaan; caalim. 2. Sh. ah: neef ido ah oo wada cad. la-mid: sheekh.
shiil: shiil¹: m.l/dh (-lal/-lo, m.l) 1. Qodob madaxiisa ballaaran oo inta la kululeeyey wax buka lagu gubayo. 2. Barta ama raadka uu oogada ku reebo dabkaas. 3. Sh. ah: dhagax madow oo marka la isku dhufto dab bixiya. 4. Sh. ah: midab aad u madow oo dadku yeesho.
shiil²: m.dh Dhagax dab lagu kululeeyey oo caddaaday.
shiil³: f.g1 (-iilay, -iishay) 1. Subag ama saliid kulul wax ku bislayn. 2. Burcad subag iyo caaneeyo u kala saarid. m.f.dh, shiilid.
shiilan: f.mg4 (-lnaa, -lnayd) Wax la shiilay ahaansho. m.f.dh, shiilnaan. la-mid: shiilaysan.
shiilcad: m.l (jool.) Dhagax dhadhaab dhalan rogan ah, iniinyaha uu ka koobanyahana ay roo-roon yihiin, wuxuuna ka soo askunmay dhagax buuradeed.
shiilo: f.g3 (-iishay, -iilatay) 1. Subag ama saliid wax ku bislaysasho. 2. Burcaddhalaalsasho. m.f.dh, shiilasho.
shiimo: m.dh.kh 1. Sh. ah: meel kayn ah. 2. Sh. ah: meel dadka ama xooluhu ku badanyihiin oo buuq badan. la-mid: sheemo.
shiin: m.l Xarafka laba iyo tobnaad ee farta carabiga ah.
shiiq: f.mg1 (-qay, -qday) 1. Xumbo hoos u dhicid. 2. Wax buuran ama dabayl ka buuxdo yaraansho. m.f.dh, shiiqid.
shiiqiye: m.l (-yayaal, m.l/dh) (baay.) Hiddo barasho ahaan, sharaxaadda aliil, kaas oo awood badan leh marka laba aliil oo kala duwan oo hiddoside laga helo unugyo noole. Tusaale ahaan: dhererka geed salbuka ah waxa xukuma laba aliil, dheer (T) iyo cillinnimo (t). Marka labadooduba ay jiraan (Tt), taas macnaheedu waxa weeye, haddii ay unugyadu kala kaanyihiin, geedku wuu dheeryahay, maadaame 'T' ay tahay shiiqiye 't'-na ay tahay shiiqsane.
shiiqsane: m.l (-nayaal, m.l/dh) (baay.) Aliil aan awood badan lahayn, marka laba aliil oo kala duwan laga helo unugyada noole.
shiir: shiir¹: m.l Ur aan aad u qurmuunayn sida kan dhididka dadka iyo wixi lamida.
shiir²: f.mg1 (-ray, -rtay) Shiir yeelasho. m.f.dh, shiirid.
shiis: m.l (jool.) Dhadhaab dhalan rogan oo u kala jajabi karta saxanno badan oo fidsan khafiifna ah (thin plates) kulka badan iyo cadaadiska dartood.
shiish: shiish¹: m.l 1. (-shash, m.l) Kurtun yar, bir ah oo ka soo taagan dhuunta buntukha madaxeeda hore oo marka wax la nishaabayo iyada iyo fantax yar oo iyaduna buntukha meel dhexe oo hore kaga taal laysku abbaaro. 2. Nishaab; toog.
shiish²: f.g1 (-shay, -shtay) Wax nishaabid. m.f.dh, shiishid.
shiishad: m.dh Dhagax dubnadeed oo wajiga cayaarta loogu talaggalay labadiisa dhinac min lix dhibcood ku leh.
shil: m.l (-lal, m.l) Dhibaato si lama filaan ah u dhacda.
shilin: shilin¹: m.l (-mmo/-maad, m.l/dh) Lacag sarrif ah oo ka samaysan bir qiimaheeduna u dhigmo 100 senti.
shilin²: m.dh Xasharaad siddeed lugood leh oo jaadad badan, baalalna aan lahayn oo dhiigga xoolaha ku nool cudurrana keenta.
shimbir: shimbir¹: m.l/dh Cudur ku dhaca dadka iyo xoolaha oo afka qallociya.
shimbir²: m.dh (-ro, m.l) 1. Qayb ka mid ah lafdhabarleyda, oo ugax dhasha, oo dhiig kulul, baalal leh oo duusha. 2. Shimbir meel dhexaad ah, midab qurxoon oo xasharaadka cuna. la-mid: shinbir.
shimbirlibaax: m.dh 1. Shimbir af madow oo dhuuban leh, shimbiraha kalena cunta. 2. Guumays.
shineemo: m.dh (-ooyin. m.l) 1. Golaha filimada lagu daawado. 2. Filin. la-mid: sineemo.
shinni: m.dh.u 1. Xasharaad afar baal iyo oogo xaadi ku taagtaagantahay leh oo malabka samaysa. 2. Abuur; firi.
shinso: f.g3 (-saday, -satay) 1. Qof qaraabanimo ama saaxiibnimo awgeed wax uga filasho. 2. Wax manaafacaadkiisa isku hallayn. m.f.dh, shinsasho.
shintiri: f.mg2 (-iyay, -isay) Maalmo, sanado, gu'yaal iyo wixi lamida tirin. m.f.dh, shintirin.
shir: shir¹: m.l (-rar, m.l) 1. Isu imaadka dad badan isugu imaadaan meel si ay arrimo waaweyn oo u dan ah uga wada hadlaan. 2. Baabuur intiisa hore, meesha uu waduhu fariisto. 3. Waqti, goor. 4. Cayaar sacab, jaan iyo jiiba leh oo ka mid ah cayaaraha hiddaha iyo dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed oo hab dhoolatusad ah loo soo bandhigo.
shir²: m.dh Ciyaar sacab, jaan iyo miro leh kana mid ah hiddaha iyo dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed, hab dhoola tusad ahna leh.

shir³: f.g/mg1 (-ray, -rtay) 1. (f.g) Meel daloosha daboolid. 2. (f.g) Gabar la guday tolid. 3. (f.mg) Dad badan si ay uga wada hadlaan arrimo u dan ah meel ku kulmid. 4. (f.mg) Dhallinyaro cayaarta shirka dheelid. m.f.dh, shirid.
shiraac: m.l (-cyo, m.dh) 1. Maro weyn oo adag qaabab badanna loo yeelo oo lagu xiro dakhalka doonyaha, oo marka dabayshu buubiso doonyaha hore u wada. 2. Dhar adag oo qallafsan lagana dhigto darbaal iyo teendho. la-mid: shiraaq.
shiraako: m.dh 1. Hanti dad badan ka dhexeysa. 2. Sh. ah: dad dani ka dhexeyso oo leh heshiis qoran dhib iyo dheefna wadaaga. la-mid: shuraako.
shiraakow: f.mg1 (-oobay, -owday; -oobi) Shiraako noqosho. m.f.dh, shiraakoobid. la-mid: shuraakow.
shirbo: m.dh Ciyaar hees iyo sacab leh oo la tumo munaasabadaha aroosyada.
shiri: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) Dad badan si ay arrin uga doodaan meel isugu keenid. m.f.dh, shirin.
shirib: shirib¹: m.l Cayaar raggu dheelo iyadoo warmo iyo gaashaamo la qurxiyey la sito oo taagnaan iyo socodba lagu tumo.
shirib²: f.mg1 (-rbay, -ribtay; -rbi) Shirib cayaarid. m.f.dh, shirbid.
shirif: m.l Ur aan la jeclaysan oo nafleyda ka soo ura. la-mid: shuruf.
shirkad: m.dh (-do, m.l) 1. Urur ka kooban laba qof ama ka badan oo si wada jir ah hanti isugu darsada oo ku shaqaysta faa'iidadana wadaaga. 2. Xarunta shirkadda. la-mid: sharikad.
shirki: m.l Kelinnimada Alle iyo cibaadadiisa oo wax kale lala wadaajiyo.
shirqool: shirqool¹: m.l (-llo, m.dh) Tashi qarsoodi ah oo loola jeedo in cid lagu dilo ama lagu waxyeelleeyo.
shirqool²: f.g1 (-oolay, -ooshay) Cid shirqool u samayn. m.f.dh, shirqoolid.
shirweyne: m.l (-nayaal, m.l/dh) Kulan wufuud badani issugu yimaadaan oo ka wada hadlaan arrimo muhiim ah oo wejiyo badan leh.
shishe: s. Meel durugsan, meel aan dhoweyn. Tusaale: Togga shishadiisa ayay degganyihiin.
shisheeye: m.l.kh 1. Qof aan xiriir sokeeye la lahayn qolo. 2. Qof jooga dal uusan u dhalan.
shisheeye-naceyb: m.l (c.naf) Cabsi, ama neceeb aad u qabtid dadka waddamada kale.
shixnad: m.dh (-do, m.l) Xamuul doon ama markab hal mar qaado.
shoob: shoob¹: m.l 1. Xarrago; mardaadi. 2. Sh. ah: neef ari ah oo leh qoobab cascas.
shoob²: f.mg1 (-bay, -btay) Cid mardaadiyid. m.f.dh, shoobid.
shood: m.dh (-do, m.l) Weel bir ka samaysan oo badarka iyo wixi lamida lagu beegto, una dhiganta suus barkii (banaadir).
shoofanisam: m.l Caadifad muujinayso in qofku uu si daran u aaminsan yahay in dalkiisa iyo dadkiisina ay ka muhiim sanyihiin ama ka fiicanyihiin dadyowga kale.
shoog: m.l (daaw.) Xaalad cudureed la socota marka cadaadiska dhiigwareegga uu aad hoos ugu dhaco oo uu dhiiggu gaari waayo soohyada.
shooko: m.dh (-ooyin, m.l) 1. Qalab bir ah oo af godan leh, yaambadana u eg oo geedaha lagu qoro. 2. la-mid: shookad. Yaambo yar oo xooggan oo dhulka adag lagu falo.
shoolad: m.dh (-do, m.l) 1. Markabka meesha qiiqu ka baxo. 2. Dhuun kasta oo dheer korna u taagan oo qiiqa kor u saarta. 3. Qalab bir ka samaysan, gaas ku shaqeeya oo wax lagu karsado.
shub: shub¹: m.l 1. Dhis ka samaysan bir, ciid, quruurux iyo shamiinto isku dhafan oo isku qallalay. 2. Cayaar ka mid ah cayaaraha hiddaha iyo dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed, leh jiib iyo jaan oo ragga iyo dumarku wada dheelan.

shub²: f.g1 (-bay, -btay) 1. Hoore meel ku geddin. 2. Xoolo waraabin. 3. Lacag bangi dhigid. 4. Quruurux, ciid, shamiinto iyo wixi lamida dhismo ka samayn. 5. Bir iyo wixi lamida dhalaalin. m.f.dh, shubid.
shuban: shuban¹: m.l Saxaro badan, jilicsan oo nafleyda qaarkeed gadaal ka dhigto.

shuban²: m.l (daaw.) Saxaro jilicsan ama biyo ah oo la dhigo si is daba joog ah. Waxa sabab u noqon kara xiidmaha oo bukooda (infekshan, kolaytis, iyo cudurka 'crohn'), dheefdhuuqa oo xumaata, xaaladaha acsaabtu kacsantahay iyo wixi lamida. Shubanku haddii uu dheeraado ama si daran u socdo wuxu keeni karaa: biyo aad u badan,cusbooyin iyo nafaqo kale oo jirka ka baxa.
shuban³: f.mg1 (-bmay, -bantay; -bmi) 1. Nafley wax shuban ku dhacay noqosho. 2. Hoore wax la shubay noqosho. m.f.dh, shubmid.
shuban⁴: f.mg4 (-bnaa, -bnayd) 1. Hoore wax la shubay ahaansho. 2. Xoolo wax la waraabshay ahaansho. m.f.dh, shubnaan.
shubo: f.g3 (-btay, -batay) 1. Hoore, badar iyo wixi lamida meel ku geddisasho. 2. Xoolo waraabsasho. m.f.dh, shubasho.
shucaac: m.l 1. Iftiinka qorraxda. 2. Tamarta ka dhalata mataataxa ku dhaca walxaha qaarkood, sida yuraaniyanka iyo wixi lamida.
shucayb-sacaaf: m.l (cilmiga naflayda) Noolayaal yaryar oo dul sabbeeya biyaha badaha iyo harooyinka. Shucaybsacaafka waxa ka mid ah xayawaannada iyo dhirta ili ma-aragtayga ah, sida aljiga, borotosoowaha iyo wixi lamida.
shufeer: m.l (-rro, m.dh) Qof baabuur wada; wade.
shuftannimo: m.dh (taar.) Dagaalyahan ee dagaallamaaya oo ka mid ah ciidan aan rasmi ahayan, ee ka soo horjeeda ciidamada dawladda iyo booliska; jabhad.
shufto: m.dh (-ooyin, m.l) Dad u banbaxay dhac, dil iyo boob.
shugri: f.mg1/2 (-iyay, -iday/-isay; -iyi) Ku sh.: cid u mahad celin. m.f.dh, shugriyid.
shuhub: m.l (c.fal) Gabal ka soo go'ay maatar adag oo soo galay gibilka qaybtiisa sare kana yimid dulalaati sare,lagana arko dhulka, ilays ka dhasha isxoqidda isaga iyo hawada uu soo dhexmarayo awgeed.
shukaami: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) 1. Haweenay xodxodasho. 2. Qof qalqaalin. 3. Doon, markab iyo wixi lamida wadid. m.f.dh, shukaamin.
shukaan: m.dh (-mmo, m.l) 1. Meesha uu fariisto qofka wada baabuur, markab,dayuurad iyo wixi lamida. 2. Isku joog garangar ama wax u dhigma iyo xubno kale ka kooban oo gaadiidka badda, cirka iyo dhulka ninka wadaa uu adeegsado.
shukaanso: f.g3 (-saday, -satay) 1. Haweeney xodxodasho. 2. Cid qalqaalsasho. m.f.dh, shukaansasho.
shuko: m.dh (-ooyin, m.l) Maro badanaa midab madow leh oo dumarka Muslinka ahi qaataan oo oogada dhan wada qarisa; shaadir.
shukul: f.g1 (-ulay, -uùshay) 1. Wax sukuliye ku tumid. 2. Badar si isha looga bixiyo aayar tumid. 3. Digir duban qob ka qaadid. m.f.dh, shukulid. la-mid: sukul.
shukulaato: m.dh Nooc macmacaanka ka mid ah oo midab bunni ah leh lana cuno.
shukumaan: m.l (-nno, m.dh) Maro duf leh oo badanaa suuf ka samaysan oo biyaha laysaga tirtiro.
shulshul: m.l (-llo, m.dh) 1. Laalaabka googaradaha haweenka, daahyada, dariishadaha iyo albaabadu ay ku yeeshaan meesha dulaca laga geliyo. 2. Raamaha loo yeelo darfaha maryaha qaarkood ee lagu qurxiyo.
shurbad: m.dh Meseggo, qamadi iyo wixi lamida oo la budeeyey si biyo-biyo ahna loo kariyey oo badanaa soonka lagu afuro; mushaalli.
shuruud: m.dh 1. Ballan hore loo dhigtay. 2. Qodob muhiim ah in la fuliyo. 3. (w) eeg sharad 1 (2).
shushub: m.l 1. Dabaadiga guga xilli roob aad u badani ka da'o gobollada koonfureed gaar ahaan jubbooyinka. 2. Shulshul. 3. Sh. ah: cadar, saliid iyo wixi lamida oo waxyaabo la isku dardaray ka kooban.

wadnabbaab²: f.mg1 (-bay, -btay) Baahi ama tabar yaro darteed la diidid. m.f.dh, wadnabbaabid.
wadnaqabad: m.l W. ah: qof aad u dhib badan oo la karaahiyaysto.
wadne: m.l (cilmiga naflayda) Xubin muruq ka samaysan, hoos ka daloosha oo leh qaab toobineed kuna sugan bartamaha saableyda, afkiisuna uu yaraha bidix u janjeero, ahna xubin dhexaadka dhiigga jirka u gudbisa. la-mid: wadno.
wadnejoogsi: m.l (daaw.) Joogsashada garaca wadnaha oo badanaa dhacda marka muruqyada bilaabaan inay si dhakhso badan u garaacaan dhiigna ayan soo saareyn (fibrilleshin) ama wadnahuba joosado.

wado: f.g3 (-atay, -adatay) 1. Xoolo, dad, gaadiid iyo wixi lamida kaxaysasho. 2. Hawl la qabanaayey sii fulin. m.f.dh, wadasho.

wagdo: wągdo: m.l Qaabxumo yar oo lugaha gasha oo ay gedow ama labo qaanso oo afafka isku haya oo kale u ekaadaan; hogfo,. la-mid: wegdo.
wahsi: wahsi¹: m.l Daal ka cararid darteed hawsha culays laga dhigo oo laga cagajiido.
wahsi²: m.l (fiisikis) Astaan maatarku leeyahay, ee sababta in ay walaxi iska caabbido isbeddelka ku imaan kara xaaladdeeda socod ama negi.
wahso: f.mg3 (-saday, -satay) Hawl caajisnimo darteed la qaban waayid. m.f.dh, wahsasho.
wajac: m.l 1. Xanuun yar. 2. Cudur weylaha ku dhaca oo ay la jibaadaan.
wajahad: m.dh (-do, m.l) (fiisikis) Jiidda dhulka dushiisa ah ee u dhexaysa kalana saarta cufaf hawo qabow iyo mid diirran ah.
wajimacbuus: m.l.kh Qof dabci xun oo had iyo jeer in uu caraysan yahay la moodo.
waji-nasasho: m.dh (baay.) Heer meertada unugga ah, oo ah marka unuggu diyaarinayo qaybsanka bu'da. Heerkan DNA-du way badataa si ay u soo saarto unugyo ku filan oo mataanaysan.
waji-tabaabulshe: m.l (-ayaal, m.l/dh) (baay.) Heerka ugu horreeya qaybsanka bu'da, taas oo koromosoomyada iyo koromaatidhyadu aad u muuqdaan halka ay bu' yarada iyo xuubka bu'du ay bilaabaan inay baaba'aan.
wajixumo: m.dh Ceeb weyn. Tusaale: Cali arrintii uu galay w. ayaa ka raacday.
wakaalad: m.dh (-do, m.l) 1. Hay'ad dawladeed oo hawl gaar ah u qaybsan oo wasaarad hoos tagta. 2. Warqad si sharci ah u qoran oo qofka haysta siisa karti uu dano ama hawlo qof kale leeyahay ku maamulo oo wakiil uga ahaado.

wakiilo: f.g3 (-iishay, -iilatay) Cid kale wakiil ka dhigasho. m.f.dh, wakiilasho.
wal: s. 1. Nin w.ba: nin kastaba. 2. W.ba: kasta. la-mid: walba.
walaac: walaac²: f.mg1 (-cay, -cday) 1. Laba arrin kala doorashadood ku fikirid. 2. Dhibaato yar xal degdeg ah u waayid. m.f.dh, walaacid.

walaal: m.l (-lo, m.dh) Wiil waxa uu u yahay wiil ama gabar ay wada dhasheen.
walaalee: f.g2 (-leeyay, -laysay) Walaalo ka dhigid (cid). m.f.dh, walaalayn.
walaaq: f.g1 (-qay, -qday) 1. Wax la rabo in ay isdhexgalaan qasid. 2. Meel deggan qas ka kicin. m.f.dh, walaaqid.
walaaqan: f.mg4 (-qnaa, -qnayd) Wax la walaaqay ahaansho. m.f.dh, walaaqnaan.
walaayo: m.dh 1. Mas'uuliyadda aabbaha ka saaran mehrinta gabadhiisa. 2. Ardi w.: dhul fog; dhul shisheeye.

walbahaar: walbahaar²: f.mg1 (-ray, -rtay) Dareen murugo leh la gam'i waayid. m.f.dh, walbahaarid.

wanqar: wanqar¹: m.l (-rro, m.dh) Dhaawac halis ah.

wanqar²: m.l 1. (xisaab) Guud ahaan, shaxan ama tibaax waxa la yiraahdaa waa wanqaranyahay haddii qaybo ka mid ah shaxanka ama tibaaxda la isku beddel karo iyada oo aan shaxanka ama tibxaha la doorin. Shaxan joometariyeed waxa uu leeyahay wanqar noqod haddii baro ku yaalla shaxanka ay leeyihiin baro ku aaddan oo ka soo noqday bar kale oo loo yaqaan xuddun wanqareed, xarriiq wanqareed ama sallax wanqareed. 2. (xisaab) Shaxan kasta oo loo qaybin karo laba qaybood oo middiiba midka kale uu u yahay humaag muraayadeed shaxan sallax ah waxa uu leeyahay ugu yaraan hal xarriiq wanqareed oo u qaybisa laba humaag muraayadeed. Xarafka A waa wanqaranyahay; is mana beddelo marka muraayad lagu eego. Hase yeeshe, xarafka R ma aha wanqar. m.f.dh, wanqarid.
waqaf: waqaf¹: m.l Hanti maguurto ah oo Ilaah dartiis loo hibeeyay.

war: war¹: m.l (-rar, m.l) 1. Wax aan hore loo ogeyn oo laysu sheego. 2. Hadal.

waraabsan: f.mg4 (-naa, -nayd) 1. Nafley wax la waraabiyey ahaansho. 2. Beer wax biyo lagu sii daayey ahaansho. m.f.dh, waraabsanaan.

wareento: m.dh Cudur xanuun kulul leh oo badanaa ku dhaca feeraha.

wargeli: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) Cid war aysan horay u hayn gaarsiin ama u sheegid. m.f.dh, wargelin.

warhee: f.g/mg2 (-heeyay, -haysay) Ka w.: arrin iyo wixi lamida meesha ay mareyso la socosho. 2. Ka w.: cid dhaqaale u baahan taakulayn. m.f.dh, warhayn.

warqab: f.mg1 (-bay, -btay) 1. Ka w.: wax xaaladda ay ku sugan yihiin ogaasho. 2. Ka w.: cid dhaqaalayn ama daryeelid. m.f.dh, warqabid.
warqad: m.dh (-do, m.l) 1. Baalal xalxalleefsan oo jiljilicsan oo wax lagu qorto. 2. Xaashi qoran oo la isu diro. la-mid: waraaq, warqaad.
warran: f.mg1 (-amay, -antay; -ami) 1. War sheegid ama ku hadlid. 2. Ka w.: cid ama arrin wax la xiriira sheegid. 3. U w.: cid xog aysan ogayn u sheegid. m.f.dh, warramid.
warroon: f.mg4 (-naa, -nayd) U w.: qof, qof kale arrin uga xogogaalsan ahaansho. m.f.dh, warroonaan.
warshad: m.dh (-do, m.l) Dhis makiinado waaweyn yaalliin oo alaabta ceeriin lagu farsameeyo. la-mid: wershad.
warshadaysan: f.mg4 (-snaa, -snayd) Wax la warshadeeyey ahaansho. m.f.dh, warshadaysnaan.
warshadee: f.g2 (-deeyay, -daysay) Alaab ceeriin warshad gelin. m.f.dh, warshadayn.
warso: f.lg3 (-saday, -satay) Cid arrin xog ka haysa wax weyddiin. m.f.dh, warsasho.
waryaa: u.j (w. waryaaya) Erey lala hadle labood ah dareenkiisa lagu soo jeediyo. u.j.w, waryaaya; ar, aryaa, waar, war. la-mid: waryee.

waswaasi: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) Cid waswaas ku abuurid. m.f.dh, waswaasin. la-mid: wiswisi.
watar: m.l Salaad sunne ah, habeenkii la tukado oo rakcadaheedu tiro kisi ah yihiin. la-mid: witir.
wax: m.l (-xyaalo/-xyaabo, m.l) 1. Shay; walax. 2. Arrin; talo; xaal. m.l.w, waxyaabo. m.l.w, waxyaalo.

waxar: waxar²: m.dh (-ro, m.l) Dhasha riyaha tooda yar. waxaraxir m.dh (c.fal.) Meerayaasho qorraxda tan ugu iftiin badan, waxayna u dhexeysaa dhulka iyo dusaaga (cuddaarka) sannakeedu waa 225 maalmood, qorraxdana waxay u jirtaa toddobaatan ku dhowaad malyuun oo mayl; xiddigta waaberi; sahra.

waxsoosaar: m.l 1. (dhaq.) Tirada wixii ka soo baxa warshadaha, beeraha, xoolaha, iyo wixi lamida. 2. (dhaq.) Natiijada waxqabad hawleed kasta. la-mid: waxsoosaarid.
waxsoosaarid: m.dh Awoodda waxqabad ee wax leeyihiin. la-mid: waxsoosaar.
waxtar: m.l 1. Qiimaha isticmaal ee wax leeyihiin. 2. Nafaqada raashin laga helo. 3. W. ah: nafley waxqabad leh. 4. la-mid: waxtarid.

xeerka noqodka: m.l 1. (fiisikis) Fallaadh abbaarka, fallaadh noqodka iyo liganuhuba waa isku sallax. 2. (fiisikis) Xagal abbaarka (i) = xagal noqodka (r) wuxuna sax ku yahay noqodka ka dhaca dulaha muraayadaha obtikaad ee sallaxa ah iyo kuwa xoodanba.
xeerka qalloocsanka: m.l 1. (fiisikis) Xagal abbaarka, xagal qalloocsanka iyo liganuhuba waa isku sallak. 2. (fiisikis) Saamiga sayni iyo sayn r waa madoorsoome marka ay u gaar yihiin labada dhextaal ee tebinaya. Taas oo i = xagal abbaarka, r = xagal qalloocsanka.
xeerka sayn: m.l (xisaab) Saddex-xagal kasta saamiga dhererka dhinaca marka loo eego saynka xagasha ka horjeedda dhinacaasi waa isku mid dhammaan saddexda dhinac. Sidaa daraadeed saddex-xagal dhinacyadiisu ay yihiin a, biyo c, xaglihiisuna ay yihiin A, B iyo C. Jidka waa a = b = c taas oo ay tahay dhinaca kahorjeeda xagasha A, b-tahay dhinaca kahorjeeda xagasha B iyo c-na tahay dhinaca ka horjeeda xagasha C.
xeerka 2aad ee Niyuuton: m.l (fiisikis) Dhaqsaha isbeddelka dahfad ay walaxi leedahay wuxu saamiggal ku yahay xoogga falaya, waxa ayna qaadataa jihada xooggu u falmayo.
xeerka 3aad ee Niyuuton: m.l (fiisikis) Fal waliba waxa uu leeyahay falgal le'eg lidna ku ah falkaas.
xeerneefeed: m.l (fiisikis) Xeerarka la xidhiidha heerkulka cadaadiska iyo mugga ee neef cufkeedu go'an yahay. Xeerarka neefta ee ugu muhiimsani waa xeerka Boyle iyo kan Jaarlee.
xeero: m.dh (-ooyin, m.l) Weel godan oo qori ka samaysan oo cuntada lagu rito.
xeeryaqaan: m.l (-nno, m.dh) Qof sharci ku takhasusay ama aad u yaqaan.
xer: m.dh.u 1. Dad koox ah oo sheekh raacsan ama wax ka barta. 2. X. ah: nin u go'ay barashada diinta oo hadba meel u aada kutub raacasho.
xerageli: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) 1. Soo x.: wax kasbid. 2. Wax tacbid. m.f.dh, xeragelin.
xeraysan: f.mg4 (-snaa, -snayd) Wax la xereeyey ahaansho. m.f.dh, xeraysnaan.
xerayso: f.g/mg.3 (-stay, -satay) 1. (f.g) Wax xero gashasho. 2. (f.mg) Xer noqosho. m.f.dh, xeraysasho.
xeree: f.g2 (-reeyay, -raysay) Xoolo iyo wixi lamida xero gelin. m.f.dh, xerayn.
xero: m.dh (-ooyin, m.l) 1. Meegaar dhagax ah ama ood ama qoryo, oo xoolo ama wax kale loo dhigo; derbi wareegsan oo illin laga galo leh; mooro; siibad. 2. Meel dugsiga ka weyn oo xertu wax ku barato.
xeroo: f.mg3 (-ooday, -ootay) Xoolo iyo wixi lamida xero gelid.
xeydo: f.g3 (-ytay, -ydatay) Maro dacalkeeda hoose kor u qaadasho. m.f.dh, xeydasho.
xiddigcirif: m.dh (c.fal.) Xiddigta laga arko kugta cirifka woqooyi, ee sidaas, lagu calaamadaysto woqooyiga runta ah ee meeshii laga arki karo ee dhulka oogadiisa, sida, kubbad-badka woqooyi.
xiddig: xiddig¹: m.l 1. Wax iftiin leh oo hawada sare ku sugan oo aan dayaxa iyo qorraxda midna ahayn oo habeenkii kaliya la arko. 2. (riw.) Ninka koowaad ee loo xusho jilidda filimada, riwaayadaha iyo wixi lamida. 3. Qof cayaaryahan ah oo kooxdiisa aad uga muuqda. 4. Nasiib.

xiddig²: m.dh (-go, m.l) 1. Wax iftiin leh oo habeenkii hawada sare laga arko. 2. (riw.) Haweeney riwaayadaha iyo filimada jisha. 3. Bir yar oo midab qurxoon leh iyo shangees oo ciidamada derejo ahaan loo siiyo.
xiddigdhul: m.l/dh Bahal yar oo wada qodax ah. xiddigi f.mg2 (-iyay, -isay) Xiddigo ka faalin. m.f.dh, xiddigin.
xiddigiye: m.l (-yayaal, m.l/dh) Qofka xiddigaha wax ka sheega ama faaliya; xiddigasheeg.
xiddigle: m.l (-layaal, m.l/dh) Sargaal ciidan oo hal xiddig leh.
xidhyar: m.dh (botani) Geedaaley yar oo har leh; geedo isku urursan oo ku yaal meel gaar oo bannaan.
xidid: xidid¹: m.l (-do, m.l) 1. Geedka intiisa dhulka ku aasan, laamaha iyo faraqa ka baxa mid ka mid ah. 2. Dhuumaha oogada nafleyda ka buuxa oo dhiigga halbowleyaashu xubnaha ku faafiyeen, soo qaada oo wadnaha ku soo celiya. 3. Xiriir dadku yeesho oo xagga guurka ka yimaada.

xidid²: m.l (-do, m.l) (xisaab) 1. Xididka tiro maangal ama murakab ah: waa tiro marka la dul dhigo jibbaar ay la mid tahay tiradaasi. Tusaale ahaan, 2 waa xidid afraadka ee 16 (2 =16). 2. Xididka isle'eg: tiro marka lagu beddelo doorsoomaha ku jira isle'egta raaligeliya isle'egta, kaas oo labada dhinac ee isle'egtu isle'ekeysiiya.
xididbarar: m.l (cilmiga naflayda) Arooreyaal debca, dheeraada oo laallaabma.
xidid-ciriirshe: m.l (-shayaal, m.l/dh) (daaw.) Dawo keenta in xididdada dhiigga ay isku rooraanoo ay ciriirshaan socodka dhiigga.
xidid-dabciye: m.l (-yayaal, m.l/dh) (daaw.) Dawo keenta ballaarashada xididdada dhiigga oo badisa socodka dhiigga.
xididdeyso: f.mg3 (-stay, -satay) 1. Xidid yeelasho. 2. Ku x.: meel mudda badan ku sugnaansho. m.f.dh, xididdeysasho.
xididmaskaxeed: m.l 1. Dhuuxa dheer oo lafdhabarta, intiisa kore oo riciraha tunka. 2. Mid ka mid ah sooha cad oo maskaxda, maskaxyarada iyo dhuuxdheeraha, sida saymo uga kala leexda oo oogada meesheed walba ka iltiran.
xididshe: m.l (-shayaal, m.l/dh) (kiim.) Atam ama koox atammo ah oo leh elektroon madi ah (aan lammaanayn). Xididsheyaasha soocani aad bay u firfircoon yihiin; waxana lagu dejin karaa ama lagu takoori karaa xaalado gaar ahaaneed oo keliya.
xidig: m.l (-go, m.l) (baay.) Jidh ku dhex samaysma unugga, marka ay dhacayaan mayoosiska iyo mitoosisku, kaasi oo ka qayb qaata filiqsanaanta koromatidhyada bu'da unugga hooyada.
xidinxiito: m.dh 1. Shinbir yar oo af guduudan iyo lugo aad u dhuudhuuban leh. 2. X. ah: qof aad caato u ah. la-mid: xiidxiito, xiito.
xifaalee: f.g2 (-leeyay, -laysay) Cid si kaftan ah wax uga sheegid. m.f.dh, xifaalayn.
xifaalo: m.dh Si hufan oo maad leh oo wax laysaga sheego; kaftan.
xig: f.g1 (-gay, -gtay) 1. Wax, wax kale u dhowaansho. 2. Xiriir qaraabanimo yeelasho. m.f.dh, xigid.
xigo: f.mg3 (-gtay, -gatay) 1. Neef dhowaan la maalay mar kale maalid. 2. Hadal, maanso iyo wixi lamida oo horay loo sheegay tixraacid. m.f.dh, xigasho.
xigsii: f.lg2 (-iiyay, -iisay) Wax meel ku sugan wax kale ag dhigid. m.f.dh, xigsiin. la-mid: xiji.
xigsinayn: m.dh (fiisikis) Hab lagu raadiyo dhakhsaha uu hal xaddi doorsoome isla beddelo xaddiga doorsoome kale. Tusaale ahaan baabuur baa socday fogaanta x1 ilaa x2 waqtiga u dhexeeya t1 ilaa t2. Xawaare celceliska babuurku waa (x2-x1)/(t2-t1) oo loo qori karo Dx/Dt, taas oo x ay u tagantahay isbeddelka x ee waqtiga t.
xigso: f.g/mg3 (-saday, -satay) 1. (f.g) Cid meel fadhida ag fariisasho. 2. (f.g) Cid qaraabo ka dhigasho. 3. (f.mg) Ka x.: cid dhib ka furasho. m.f.dh, xigsasho.
xiidan: xiidan¹: m.l 1. Dhuunta cunnadu marto, inteeda u dhexaysa caloosha iyo afka saxaradu ka baxdo. 2. Cunnammareenka intiisa yaryar oo caloosha (godanta) iyo qabsinnada u dhexaysa.

xiidan²: m.l (cilmiga naflayda) Qaybta ka midka mindhicirka weyn ee lafdhabarleyda ee u dhexaysa siikamka iyo malawadka. Shaqada ugu weyn ee uu qabtaana waxa weeye ka soo nuugista macaadinta iyo biyaha hadhaaga cuntada aan la dheefshiidin ee soo dhaafta mindhicirka yar, taas oo marka dambe noqota saxarro.
xiidmo: m.l Dheefshiidka intiisa yaryar oo ay ku dhammaato calooshu iyo qabsiinnada u dhexeeya.
xiiji: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) Nafley orod ku daalin, nafley xuurtaysiin. m.f.dh, xiijin. la-mid: xiiqi.
xiimi: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) 1. Wax xiin ka keenid. 2. Wax aad u ordisiin. m.f.dh, xiimin.
xiin: xiin¹: m.l 1. Waxa xoog u wareegaya ama u ordaya, shanqarta ka yeerta. 2. Sayn roob ah oo xoog iyo dheerayn leh.
xiin²: f.mg1 (-iimay, -iintay; -iimi) 1. Aad u ordid. 2. Matoor baabuur iyo wixi lamida dhawaaqid. m.f.dh, xiimid.
xiinto: m.dh (-ooyin, m.l) Webiyada, durdurrada iyo wixi lamida meelaha biyadhaca ah oo xiinka sameeya.
xiiq: xiiq¹: m.dh 1. Neef xoog leh oo nafleyda qabata kolka in badan la ordo; xuurto. 2. Xiiqdheer; kix.
xiiq²: m.dh (daaw.) Xaalad bukaansho oo lagu yaqaan iskuroorid kedis ah ee dhuumaha neefta taaso keenta dhibaato neefsasho.
xiiq³: f.mg1 (-qay, -qday) Xiiq qabsasho; xuurtoodid. m.f.dh, xiiqid.
xiiqdheer: xiiqdheer¹: m.dh Cudur qufac badan leh oo carruurta ku dhaca. la-mid: kix.

xiiqdheer²: m.dh (daaw.) Cudur la isqaadsiiyo ee muddo gaaban, inta badanku dhaca caruurta oo uu keeno caabuq (mucosa) xuubka malaaska ee cunaha baktiiriyumka loo yaqaan 'bordatella pertussis'. Kalhuuriska oo ah 1-2 toddobaad ka dib waxa bilowda xaako, qandho fudud, qufac iyo cunno xumo. Qufacu wuxu noqdaa mid soo noqnoqda soona kordha: qofacyo gaagaaban oo isku xigxiga waxa raacaya neef jeed khasab ah taas oo sameyneysa codkii kixda. Waxa sida badan dhacda dhiigbax sanka iyo afka ka yimaada iyo matag qufaca xiriirka ah ka yimaada.
xiiqsan: f.mg4 (-naa, -nayd) Wax xiiqay ahaansho. m.f.dh, xiiqsanaan.
xiir: f.g1 (-ray, -rtay) Timo iyo wixi lamida gun ka jarid. m.f.dh, xiirid.
xiiran: f.mg4 (-rnaa, -rnayd) Wax la xiiray ahaansho. m.f.dh, xiirnaan.
xiiro: f.g3 (-rtay, -ratay) Timo madax ama gar ka jarasho. m.f.dh, xiirasho.
xiirrimaad: m.l Gun ka jaridda timo iyo wixi lamida gunta laga jaro. la-mid: xiirimaad.
xiis: f.g/mg1 (-say, -stay) 1. (f.g) Xargo dhowr ah isku soohid. 2. (f.mg) U x.: wax u hiloobid. m.f.dh, xiisid.
xiisad: m.dh 1. Biya ama dabayl si xooggan u socda. 2. (-do, m.l) Qas iyo qalaanqal xasilloonida degaan wax u dhima.
xiisadhac: f.mg1 (-cay, -cday; -dhici) Ka x.: wax rabiddooda dhumin; xiiso wax loo qabay lumin. m.f.dh, xiisadhicid.
xiisee: f.g2 (-seeyay, -saysay) Wax araggooda ama heliddooda aad u rabid. m.f.dh, xiisayn.
xiiso: m.l Wax la jeclaan jiray, kolka danbe oo la helo, rabitinka la iska dareemo ama loo qaado ama lagula dhaco.
xiiso-elektaroon: m.l (-ooyin ..., m.l) (fiisikis) Summadda A ayaa lagu asteeyaa. Tamarta baxda marka atam, molikuyuul ama koox ku sugan weji neefeed ay hesho elektaroon si ay u noqoto ayoon taban. Waxa markaas ay noqonaysaa tamarta: A+ e--> A- . Qiimaha togan ee A (halbeeggeedu waa elektaroonfoolt) wuxuu tilmaan u yahay in kul la bixiyey.
xijaab: xijaab¹: m.l (-byo, m.dh) 1. Wax wax celiya ama isku gudba ama qariya; daah; ilixir. 2. Qardhaas; xirsi; makaraan.
xijaab²: f.g1 (-bay, -btay) 1. Wax qarin. 2. Wax dhibaato ka celin. m.f.l, xijaabid.
xijaaban: f.mg4 (-bnaa, -bnayd) Wax la xijaabay ahaansho. m.f.dh, xijaabnaan.
xijaabo: f.mg3 (-btay, -batay) 1. Wax xijaab ka dhigasho. 2. Qof muslim ah dhimasho. m.f.dh, xijaabasho.
xiji: xiji¹: m.l Dhirta xabagta udgoon dhasha oo moxorka iyo yagcartu ka mid yihiin.
xiji²: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) Ku x.: wax, wax kale u dhoweyn ama raacin. m.f.dh, xijin.
xil: m.l 1. Xishood; sheex; sarriig. 2. Wax ama hawl la isu dhiibay ama la is faray ama la qabanayo, wixii ceebaal ah, ama naftii sharaf lihi ka xishooto, oo ka imaan kara haddii la hargado ama lagu gaboodfalo. 3. Ceebal; fadeexo.
xilafur: m.l 1. Xilaha la qabo oo si sharci ah loo sii daayo, loo furo; dalaaq. 2. Dhaar lagu dhaarto in xilaha la furayo.
xilagube: m.l (-bayaal, m.l/dh) Nin ooridiisa u daran.
xilbax: f.mg1 (-xay, -xday; -bixi) Waajib qof saarraa si fiican u gudasho. m.f.dh, xilbixid.
xildhibaan: m.l (-nno, m.dh) 1. Xubin gole shacbi ka tirsan. 2. Qof xil qaadi kara.
xildiid: m.dh Xabag midab dambar-cad ah, ur silloon iyo dhadhan kharaar leh oo daawo ahaan loo isticmaalo.
xilkas: m.l.kh 1. Qof xilka garan og; xildhibaan. 2. Neef irmaan oo madi ah, oo lagu xilbaxo.
xilli: xilli¹: m.l (-iyo, m.dh) 1. Waqti; goor; ammin. 2. Nur.

xilli²: m.l (-iyo, m.dh) (c.fal.) Xilliyo sannadeed oo lagu garto xaalado gaar ahaaneed ee cimilo, inta badanna ay keento janjeedhka udub dhexaadka dhulka e tub qorraxeedka iyo meereysiga dhulka ee qorraxda. Loolalka dhexe, afar xilli, oo midkiiba saddex bilood yahay, waxa guud ahaan lagu gartaa: kubbad-badhka woqooyi. Gugu waa maarso, abril iyo maajo; xagaagu waa juun, luulyo iyo agoosto; dayrta waa sebtembar, oktoobar iyo noofembar; jiilaalkuna waa diisembar, janaayo iyo febraayo. Kubbad-badhka koonfureedna xilliyaddu waa lidka kuwan, gugu waa sebtembar, oktoobar iyo noofembar, iyo wixi lamida. Xilliyada xiddigis ahaan waxaa loo tixgeliyaa taariikho gaar ahaaneed.
xilo: xilo¹: m.l.u Haweenka la qabo; oori; afo; maranti; naag.
xilo²: f.mg3 (-ishay, -ilatay) U x.: wax dan moodid; wax u iilasho, wax u eexasho. m.f.dh, xilasho.
xilqaan: f.g1 (-aamay, -aantay; -aami) Is x.: is adeejin, wax isu dirid, xil isa saarid. m.f.l, xilqaamid.
xilqo: m.dh Saf wareegsan oo dad taag ah ama fadhiya oo digrinaya; xilqad.
xiltir: f.g1 (-ray, -rtay) Qof hawl cid laga sugaayey fulinteeda isu xilsaarid. m.f.dh, xiltirid.
xilwareejin: m.dh La kala wareegidda laba qof maamul la kala wareegaan.
ximi: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) Si xin ku jiro cid ula dhaqmid. m.f.dh, ximin.
xin: m.l 1. Colaad yar oo masayr iyo xaasidnimo leh oo dad qaraaba ahi isu qabaan. 2. (-man, m.l) Biyafariisin yaroo xareed ah.
xinif: m.dh Is necbaan yar oo dad ka dhexeysa.
xiniin: xiniin¹: m.l Nin ama neef lab ah oo hal xiniin leh.
xiniin²: m.dh (-nyo, m.l) Labada qanjir, oo ugaxda qaabkeeda leh, oo qooraha ku jira, oo biyaha laboodka sameeya, middood; raayaha middood.

xiniin³: m.dh (-nyo, m.l) (cilmiga naflayda) Labada kuus-kuus ee xubin nimeedka ah oo sameeya shahwada, soona saara hormoonka ragga (androojin) oo ku xiran hormoonno kale (goonadotrofiinis) oo laga soo daayo qanjir dhiiqa bitwitariga.
xiniinxolac: m.l (-yo, m.dh) (daaw.) Halaamacoodka xiniinyaha wuxuu keena xanuun, casaan iyo barar maqaarka xiniinyaha waxaana wehelin kara halaamacoodka dhuumaha shahwada.
xiniinyataabo: f.mg3 (-btay, -batay) Qof la raba in laga salgaaro xummaantiisa, gardarro bareer ah ku samayn. m.f.dh, xiniinyataabasho. la-mid: xiniintaabo.
xinjirroor: m.l (-ro ..., m.l) (daaw.) Xaalad dhiiggu uu ka beddelmo dareere oo uu noqdo adke oo uu sameeyo xinjir. Xinjir-awd wuxuu ku dhacaa xididdada dhiigga waana xaalad cudureed. Xinjir awdku halbowle wuxu keenaa in dhiiggu ka xirmo soohyada halbowluhu waraabin jiray intuusan xirman. Awdmidda halbowle maskaxeed waxay ka mid tahay sababaha keena dhibibka (strike); xinjir awdka halbowle wadneedna waxay keentaa wadne wareen (heart attack).
xiqdi: m.l Colaad iyo nacayb uurka lagu hayo.
xir: f.g1 (-ray, -rtay) 1. Wax xarig iyo wixi lamida ku qabasho, ku guntid. 2. Cid xabsi gelin. 3. Albaab qataarid. 4. Hawl meel ka socotay joojin. m.f.dh, xirid.
xiran: xiran¹: f.mg1 (-rmay, -rantay; -rmi) Wax la xirey noqosho. m.f.dh, xirmid.
xiran²: f.mg4 (-rnaa, -rnayd) Wax la xirey ahaansho. m.f.dh, xirnaan.
xirfad: m.dh (-do, m.l) Shaqo aqoonteeda la leeyahay oo lagu shaqaysto; meherad. la-mid: xirfo.
xirfadle: m.l (-layaal, m.l/dh) Qof gacanta ka shaqeeya oo hawsha uu qabanaayo aqoon u leh.
xiriir: xiriir¹: m.l (-rro, m.dh) 1. Qaab wax is daba yaalla ay isugu xiran yihiin. 2. Cilaaqaad ka dhexeeya laba qof ama ka badan. 3. Urur lammaaneyaal horsan, ama isku xir ka dhexeeya kutirsaneyaasha urur ama ururro.
xiriir²: f.mg1 (-ray, -rtay) 1. Wax si aan kala go' lahayn isu daba jooga noqosho. 2. La x.: arrin xogteeda cid kala hadlid. 3. la-mid: xąriir². m.f.l, xiriirid.
xiriiri: f.g2 (-iyay, -isay) 1. Dad xiriir wanaagsan la yeelasho. 2. Awr iyo wixi lamida isku daba xirid. 3. Dad, hawl iyo wixi lamida xiriir ka dhexeysiin. m.f.dh, xiriirin.
xiriiriye: xiriiriye¹: m.l (-yayaal, m.l/dh) 1. Qof barnaamijyada ka baxa raadiyaha, telefishinka iyo wixi lamida dadka la socodsiiya. 2. Wax isku xira laba shay ama ka badan.

xiriiriye²: m.l (-yayaal, m.l/dh) (naxwe) Curiyeyaal aan isbeddeleyn oo loo adeegsado xiriirin labo erey ama labo koox erey oo weer iskula jira amaba labo weerood oo kala madax bannaan. Tusaale: Sahal iyo Malyuun waa walaalo.
xiriirsan: f.mg4 (-naa, -nayd) Wax, wax kale ku daba xiran ahaansho. m.f.dh, xiriirsanaan.
xiriirso: f.g3 (-saday, -satay) 1. Wax, wax kale ku daba xirasho. 2. Cid afduubid. m.f.dh, xiriirsasho.
xiritaan: m.l 1. Xafladda lagu gebegebeeyo hawl socotay. 2. Gebegebada hawl socotay.
xirmo: m.dh (-ooyin, m.l) 1. Dhawr wax oo isku nooc ah oo isku xiran. 2. Dhul daaqsimeed muddo go'an laga xayiro daaqidda xoolaha si loogu aayo goor dambe.
xiro: f.g3 (-rtay, -ratay) 1. Wax xarig iyo wixi lamida ku qabsasho. 2. Cid xabbisasho. 3. Albaab, dariishad iyo wixi lamida qataarasho. 4. Haweeney mehersasho. 5. Dhar lebbisasho. 6. Salaad ama soon gelid. 7. Ku x.: qof kale imaam ka dhigasho. 8. Ku x.: markab, doon iyo wixi lamida marso tegid. m.f.dh, xirasho.
xirrib: m.dh 1. Isha guruxeeda iyo sanqaroorka meesha u dhexaysa. 2. Tab; dhagar; xeelad; khatal; siyaasad.
xirsi: m.l (-iyo, m.dh) 1. Warqad quraan ku qoran yahay ama wax kale oo inta idiin lagu dahaaro balaayo xijaab ahaan loo qaato. 2. Cunto, lacag, iyo wixi lamida oo balaayo xijaab ahaan loo bixiyo.
xirsifur: m.l (-ryo, m.dh) X. ah: waxa loo sadqeeyo qof sixir lagu sameeyey ama jirro darani hayso, si uu uga badbaado halista.

Na: 1) nous (objet), 2) et, 3) comme, 4) aussi, 5) aucun, 6) un des...

Oo: 1) et, 2) ce qui, 3) ce que, 4) alors que.
Sii: loin, encore plus, jusqu'à ce que.
U: le, lui. la, elle, les, eux. elles (complément d'objet).

Way: 1) elle (+ verbe), 2) ils ou elles (+ verbe).
Waynnu: nous (y compris la personne à qui l'on s'adresse, + verbe).

abdomen: (n) part of body between the chest and legs; the cavity of the human body containing the stomach, intestines, liver, gallbladder, pancreas, spleen etc.; also called the belly.
abdominal: (adj) of, or pertaining to the abdomen.
abnormal: (adj) not normal; contrary to the usual structure, position, behavior, or rule.
abortion: (n) the premature expulsion of a fetus from the uterus, or removal of a fetus not capable of living, developing, or functioning successfully.
abrasion: (n) an area of body surface where skin is removed through some mechanical process.
abscess: (n) a localized collection of pus in tissues, organs, or confined spaces.
absorption: (n) the uptake of substances into or across tissues, e.g. skin and intestine.
abstinence: (n) a refraining from the use in food, stimulants, or sexual intercourse.

abandon: /abandhan/abandoning, abandoned; (v) ka tegid aan soo nogod lahayn ama in muddo dheer ah. e.g. You should not abandon your studies.
abandoned: /abandhandh/ (adj) laga guuray (laga haajiray). e.g. Harar was abandoned during the war.
abase: /abeys/ (v) in gof la sharaf rido, ama darajada laga qaado.
abashed: /abashid/ (adj) isku xishood ama isku yaxyaxid. e.g. Sarah looked abashed in the class when she realized her mistake.
abate: /abeyt/abates, abated; (v) 1. yaraato ama gudho. e.g. My illness abated a little. (v) 2. joojin.
abattoir: /abatwar/ (n) goobta xoolaha lagu gowraco, ama xero dhiig.
abbess: /abis/abbesses (n) naagta soorooyinka kaniisadda madaxda u ah.
abbey: /abey/ (n) guryaha kaniisaddu leedahay oo ay soorooyinku degan yihiin.
abbot: /abat/ (n) wadaadka diinta ee madaxda u ah wadaadada kale.
abbreviate: /abbriviyeyt/abbreviates, abbreviating, abbreviated; (v) ereyada oo la soo gaabiyo. e.g. U.S.A. (United States of America).
abdicate: /abdhikeyt/abdicates, abdicating, abdicated; (v) 1. is casilid (v) 2. ka samrid ama ka tanaasulid hawl ama jago. e.g. The minister abdicated his responsibility.
abdomen: /abdhoman/abdomens, abdominal; (n) uusleyda ama calool ku jirta. e.g. The patient is suffering from pain in the abdomen.
abduct: /abdhakt/ abducts, abducting,abducted; (v) afduub (khasab ku kaxaysad ama xoog ku kaxaysasho).e.g. The baby was abducted from his home and held for ransom
aberration: /abarreeshan/ (n) 1. arrin ama hawl sidii loo rabay aan noqon, (n) 2. marin habow (weecsanaan).
abet: /abet/ (v) dambi ama khalad ku gargaarid ama gacan ku siin. e.g. Do not abet your friend's enemy.
abhor: /abhoor/abhors, abhorring, abhorred; (v) karaahiyaysi; necbaysasho. e.g. Mahdi abhors any form of discrimination.
abide: /abaydh/abides, abiding, abided; 1. u dul-qaadasho. e.g. I can't abide an unpunctual person. 2. daa'imid.
abide by: /abaydh baay/ (v) u hogaansanaanta sharci ama heshiis. e.g. You must abide by the law.
ability: /abiliti/abilities; (n) karti ama awood qof wax ku gaban karo. e.g. Ubax studied to the best of her ability.
abject: /abjekt/ (adj) 1. xaalad xun oo niyad jab leh. e.g. the abject situation in the Middle East. 2. aan xurmo lahayn (aan xushmad u qalmin).
ablaze: /ableys/ (adj) 1. holac ama dab meel qabsaday. e.g. Within minutes the buildings were ablaze. 2. iftiin ama dhalaal fara badan.
able: /eybal/ (adj) awoodi kara. e.g. I will be able to visit you this weekend.
ably: /eybli/ (adv) awood buuxda leh. e.g. The President was ably supported by the party members.
abnegation: /agnigayshan/ (n) dafiraad, inkiraad. e.g. The thief's abnegation was unacceptable to the judge.
abnormal: /abnoormal/abnormalities, abnormally; (adj) 1. wax aan caadi ahayn. e.g. She exhibited abnormal behaviour. (adj) 2. naadir.
aboard: /aboordh/ (adv) gaadiidka uu qof saaranyahay, sida diyaarad ama markab. e.g. The plane crashed, killing all passengers aboard.
abode: /aboodh/ (n) hoyga qof ku noolyahay. e.g. He took his bride to their new abode.
abolish: /abalish/abolishing, abolished; (v) 1. joojin, mamnuucid, (v) 2. tirtirid. e.g. The government will abolish the death penalty.
abominable: /abaminabal/ (adj) wax aad u xun oo la karaahiyaysto. e.g. Factory workers work in abominable conditions in some countries.
aboriginal: /abarijinal/ (n) dadka asalka ah ee ayagoo meel degan loogu yimaado. e.g. Canadian Indians are aboriginal people.
abortion: /aboorshan/ (n) ilmaha uurka ku jira oo si ula kac ah loo soo rido (la soo xaaqo).
abortive: /abortif/ (adj) 1. dhicisoobey. (adj) 2. lugu guul daraystay. e.g. The police made an abortive attempt to rescue the little girl.
abound: /abowndh/abounds, abounding, abounded; (v) wax tiro badan ama xaddi badan. e.g. The world of science fiction abounds with wonders.
about: /abbowt/ (prep) 1. ku saabsan. e.g. This is a book about Somalia. 2. qiyaastii. e.g. There were about ten students in the class.
above: /abbav/ (prep) 1. ka koreeya, kor. e.g. He lives in the apartment above the store. 2. ka badan.
abrasion: /abreyshan/abrasions; (n) 1. meel gofka jirkiisa diirku ka qaadmay. e.g. There was an abrasion on his thigh. (n) 2. xoqnaan.
abrasive: /abreysiv/ (adj) 1. qofka aan naxariista lahayn oo waji macbuuska ah. e.g. He is an abrasive person. 2. shay adag oo wax lugu nadiifiyo. e.g. He used an abrasive cleanser for the bathtub.
abreast: /abrest/ (adj) 1. dad ama wax is dhinac socda. e.g. Two cars were racing abreast. (adj) 2. ka war hayn. e.g. The press kept abreast of each new development.
abridged: /abrijid/ (adj) wax la soo gaabiyey, buug ama ciyaar oo kale. e.g. This is an abridged version of the book.
abroad: /abroodh/ (adv) 1. dibadda, dal shisheeye, dal qalaad. e.g. I was abroad on holiday. (adv) 2. ku baahid, fidid.
abrupt: /abrapt/abruptly; (adj) 1. wax kadis kuugu dhaca, lama filaan. e.g. The meeting came to an abrupt end. (adv) 2. qof u hadla si qabiidnimo ah oo edeb daran. e.g. I would not have spoken so abruptly if I'd known you were ill.
abscond: /abiskond/ (v) wax si qarsoodi ah loola baxsado, ama qof dhuuntay ama baxsaday. e.g. He absconded with the public funds.
absence: /absansi/absences; (n) maqnaansho. e.g. The class was very noisy during the teacher's absence.
absentee: /absantii/ (n) qofka ka magan meeshii laga rabay inuu joogo. e.g. There were no absentees in the class that day.
absent-minded: / (adj) maqane jooge, qofka kula jooga hadana maahsan. e.g. Some of the students are absent-minded when it comes to remembering their homework.
absolute: /absalut/absolutely; (adj) 1. dhamaystiran (adv) 2. wax aad carrabka ku adkeynaysid in ay sax ama run yihiin. e.g. You're absolutely right about the news.
absolve: /absolv/absolves, absolving, absolved; (v) gof dambi loo haystay lugu waayey, bari ka ah. e.g. The President is absolved from blame and responsibility over the company's loss.
absorb: /absoorb/absorbs, absorbing absorbed; (v) 1. dhuugid ama nuugid. e.g. Plants absorb water through their roots. 2. wax la liqay ama lala wareegay. e.g. small companies are often absorbed by larger ones.
absorbent: /absorbant/ (adj) alaab ama qalab wax nuuga sida isbuunyada.
absorption: /absoorbshan/ (n) 1. nuugitaan, dhuuqis. e.g. the absorption of water by a towel. (n) 2. wax aad danaynaysid (xiisaynaysid). e.g. He has an absorption in his studies.
abstain: /absteyn/abstains, abstaining, abstained; (v) 1. iska deyn wax aad sameyn jirtay, ka caagid. e.g. He will abstain from sleeping for two days. (v) 2. arrin ama doorasho aadan codkaaga ka dhiiban (ka aamustid). e.g. He abstained during the vote.
abstemious: /abstemiyas/ (adj) qofka iska joojiya ama wax yar ka qaata wax naftiisu rabto sida cuntada, cabidda. e.g. He is an abstemious eater.
abstract: /abstrakt/abstracts, abstracting, abstracted; (adj) wax aan la taaban karin.
absurd: /abserdh/absurdity; (adj) aan macquul ahayn. e.g. The government policies are absurd.
abundance: /abandhans/abundant; (n) wax aad u badan, qaraq. e.g. An abundance of food was spread out on the buffet table.
abuse: /abyuus/abuses, abusing, abused; (n) 1. caay ama aflagaado. e.g. She abuses her children. (v) 2. gof inaad ku xad gudubtid. e.g. The patients were physically abused. (n) 3. wax aad si khalad ah u isticmaashid. e.g. Drug abuse is increasing in North America.
abysmal: /abismal/ (adj) wax la liidayo ama aan tayo badan lahayn.
abyss: /abis/ (n) 1. god dheer oo aan guntiisa la gaari karin (n) 2. xaalad baqdin leh sida dagaalka 3aad ee adduunka.
AC: /ey sii/ (n) danabka qulqula ee korontada (alternating current oo la soo gaabiyey).
academy: /akadami/ (n) dugsi tacliin sare oo loogu tala galay waxbarasho gaar ah. e.g. the Lafoole Academy of Arts.
accede: /aksiid/accedes, acceding, acceded; (v) arrin aad gof ku raacdid ama u ogalaatid. e.g. I can't accede to your request.
accelerate: /akselarayt/accelerates, accelerating, accelerated; (v) 1. sheelarayn, karaarsiin. e.g. He accelerated the car. (v) 2. dadajin, ku dhakhsasho.
accelerator: /akselaratar/ (n) sheelare (qalabka lugu istaago si xawaaraha loo kordhiyo).
accent: /aksent/accents, accenting, accented; (n) 1. luqad si duwan loogu dhawaaqo ama loogu hadlo; lahjad. e.g. Hibo has a strong French accent. (n) 2. xarakada lugqad lugu dhigo oo dhawaaga badasha sida tan Carabiga.
accentuate: /aksenjuweyt/accentuates, accentuating, accentuated; (v) carrabka ku adkayn ama hadal la doonayo in muhiimadiisa la muujiyo. e.g. He accentuated the importance of education.
accept: /aksept/ accepts, accepting, accepted; (v) la ogolaado ama la yeelo. e.g. They will accept my advice when it is offered.
acceptable: /akseptabal/ (adj) wax la ogolaan karo ama laysku waafiqi karo. e.g. My idea was acceptable to the company.
acceptance: /akseptans/ (n) aqbalaad ama ogolaansho. e.g. I received my acceptance from the university.
access: /akses/accesses, accessing, accessed; (n) 1. meel jid loo maro. e.g. The access to the garage is through the gate. (n) 2. wax aad awood u leedahay inaad isticmaashid ama ogaatid. e.g. I have access to the computer.
accessible: /aksesable/ (adj) wax la gaari karo, la heli karo ama cid kasta u furan. e.g. Libraries are accessible to the public.
accession: /akseshin/ (n) 1. ku soo biirid ama wax isku darsamay. e.g. the accession of Quebec and Canada. 2. in jago sare qof loo doorto ama uu hanto. e.g. Today is the President's accession.
accessory: /aksesari/accessories; (n) 1. wax siyaada ah sida waxyaabaha baabuurta lugu qurxiyo. e.g. Bracelets and rings are fashion accessories. 2. qofka in dambi la galo gargaara ama qariya. e.g. He is an accessory to the murder.
accident: /aksident/ accidents; (n) 1. shil. e.g. He was injured in a car accident. (adj) 2. wax kadis ku dhacay, lama filaan.
accidental: /aksidental/accidentally, (adj) wax si fursad ah isaga dhacay. e.g. My meeting with him was purely accidental.
accident prone: /aksident paron/ (adj) qofka shilka u nasiibka badan; gacan fudayd.
acclaim: /akleym/acclaims, acclaiming, acclaimed; (v) 1. si fiican loo ammaanay; loo faaniyey. e.g. He was acclaimed for his writing talent. (n) 2. si xamaasad leh loo soo dhaweeyey.
acclimatize: /aklaymatays/acclimatizes, acclimatizing, acclimatized; (v) wax aad qabatintid ama u baratid. e.g. He became acclimatized to the winter.
accolade: /akaleydh/accolades; (n) billad siin sida billad geesinimo ama billad hawl karnimo. e.g. This was the highest accolade he received.
accommodate: /akomadheyt/accommodates, accommodating; (v) diyaafadin (hurdo siin, jiif siin ama guri siin). e.g. He can accommodate up to five guests.
accommodation: /akomodashan/ (n) degaan. e.g. There is no shortage of accommodation in this building.
accompaniment: /akampaniment/ (n) 1. laxanka ama codka muusiga ee hees loo sameeyo. e.g. a piano accompaniment (n) 2. shay wax la raaciyo ama lugu lammaaniyo sida iidaanka cuntada loo raaciyo oo kale.
accompany: /akambani/accompanies, accompanying, accompanied; (v) 1. u wehel yeelid ama raacid. e.g. He will accompany her to the movie (v) 2. wax raacsan wax kale, sida hargabka iyo madax xanuunku isku raacsan yihiin.
accomplice: /akomplis/ (n) qof danbiile gacan siiya. e.g. The murderer's accomplice was arrested.
accomplish: /akomplish/accomplishes, accomplishing, accomplished; (v) wax in lugu guuleysto ama la dhamaystiro. e.g. He had to accomplish his task.
accomplishment: /akomplishment/ accomplishments; (n) 1. xirfad gaar ah (qof hawl gudan kara ama si fiican u yaqaan). e.g. He has great experience and accomplishment. (n) 2. dhammaystir (guul-gaarid).
accord: /akoordh/accords, according, accorded; (n) 1. heshiis ama mucaahado. e.g. the Camp David Accord. (v) 2. guddoonsiin ama in aad gof wax u hibeysid.
accordance: /akoodhans/ (n) ayadoo la tixraacayo ama laga dabqaadanayo. e.g. In accordance with Islamic law, you must pray.
accordingly: /akoodhingli/ (adv) arrin sababsatay arin kale ama darteed u dhacday (sababtaas darteed). e.g. He stole some money and he was arrested accordingly.
according to: /akkooding to/ (prep) marka loo eego ama loo fiiriyo. e.g. According to the evidence, he is guilty.
accost: /akoost/accosts, accosting accosted; (v) qof in aad hadal ku bilowdid ama afka la gashid. e.g. I was accosted by a salesman.
account: /akownt/accounts, accounting, accounted; (n) 1. xisaabinta lacagta. e.g. He prepares his accounts carefully. 2. xisaab ama koonto kaaga furan bangi, shirkad ama dukaan. e.g. bank account.

after: /aaftar/ (prep) ka dib; ka bacdi ama ka gadaal. e.g. He arrived just after the meeting.
after-care: /aafter-keer/ (n) 1. daawaynta qofku markuu isbitaalka ama xabsiga ka soo baxo. (n) 2. baanasho.
after-effect: /aafter-ifekt/ after-effects; (n) wax-yeellayn; wax markay dhacaan waxyeelo leh. e.g. a drug with no after-effects.
aftermath: /aafter-maath/ (n) arrin ama wax dhacay natiijadood. e.g. People are still suffering the aftermath of war.
afternoon: /aaftar-nuun/ afternoons; (n) galabnimo (wakhtiga u dhexeeya duhurkii iyo makhribkii). e.g. The sun is hottest in the afternoon.
after-shave: /aafter-shayv/ (n) dareere udgoon oo raggu marsadaan markey garka iska xiiraan.
after-taste: /aafter-test/ (n) dhadhanka afka ku hara cuntada ama cabbida ka dib.
afterthought: /aafterthoot/afterthoughts; (n) wax aad tiraahdid ama sheegtid goor dambe adigoon ka fiirsan (ka fakarin).
afterward: /aafterwardh/afterwards; (adj) arrin horey u dhacday dabadeed wax dhaca; waxaas ka bacdi. e.g. She became ill and died soon afterward.
again: /ageyn/ (adv) mar kale; mar labaad. e.g. Can you try again in half an hour?
against: /agenist/ (prep) 1. ka soo hor jeeda; lid ku ah ama ka dhan ah. e.g. I am against having a picnic on Friday. (prep) 2. ku tiirsan; dhinaca ku haya ama cadaadinaya. e.g. Do not lean against the door.
age: /eeyj/ages, aging, aged;(n) 1. da' (inta qof jiro). e.g. She is ten years of age. 2. qof ama wax kale oo da'weyn. e.g. This building is for the aged people.
ageing: /eyjing/ (adj) gaboow, duq ah. e.g. an ageing teacher.
ageless: /eyjles/ (adj) 1. qof da'qarsi leh. e.g. an ageless actor. 2. waqti ama da' aan la qiyaasi karin.
agency: /eyjansi/agencies;(n) wakaalad ama wakiil. e.g. She works for an employment agency.
agenda: /ajenda/agendas;(n) waxyaabaha looga hadlayo shir ama kulan; waxyaabaha la qabanayo. e.g. What is the next point on the agenda?
agent: /eyjant/agents;(n) qof shirkad ama dowlad wakiil u ah. e.g. I would like to phone my agent in London about the situation.
age-old: /eyj-oldh/ (adj) wax in badan soo taxnaa; soo jireen ahaa. e.g. There is an age-old custom in Somalia.
aggravate: /aggraveyt/aggravates, aggravating; aggravated;(v) 1. xaalad xumayd oo aad ka sii dartid, sii xumayn ama sii qasid. e.g. He aggravated the situation. 2. ka xanaajin. e.g. His speeches always aggravate me.
aggregate: /agegrigeyt/aggregates;(n) isku dar, wadar. e.g. He spent an aggregate of ten years in different jails.
aggression: /aggreshan/ (n) dagaal gardaro ah bilaabid. e.g. It is not acceptable to commit an act of aggression against your neighbour.
aggressive: /aggresiv/aggressively, aggressiveness;(adj) gardaran ama dagaal badan. e.g. He was the only aggressive speaker in the meeting.
aggressor: /aggresar/aggressors;(n) qof ama waddan dagaal gardaro ah bilaaba.
aggrieved: /agegriivid/ (adj) ka xumaansho ama ka cabasho caddaalad darro lagu sameeyey. e.g. She felt aggrieved because she didn't get araise.
aghast: /agaast/ (adj) murugo naxdin leh. e.g. She was aghast about the murder.
agile: /aajil/agility;(adj) 1. aad u dhakhsa badan; fudfudud. e.g. the dancers's agile movements. 2. qof maskax furan; si dhakhsa ah wax u fahma.
agitate: /aajateyt/agitates, agitating, agitated;(v) 1. kicin ama baraarujin shacuurta dadweynaha. e.g. He is going to agitate for better conditions for prisoners. 2. isku buugqid; isku dhex yaacid ama welwel ku abuurid. e.g. I don't like to agitate him at this moment.
agitator: /aajateytar/agitators; (n) qofka dadka dareenkooda ama shucuurtooda kiciya. e.g. a political agitator.
agnostic: /aagnastik/agnostics; (n) qof aaminsan inaan la sugi karin jiritaanka eebbe .
ago: /agow/ (adv) waqti tagey; waqti ka hor. e.g. I was in Paris five years ago.
agog: /agag/ (adj) wax aad u hanwayn tahay oo aad sugaysid inaad ogaatid. e.g. The announcement left the city agog.
agonize: /aaganays/agonizes, agonized, agonizing;(v) 1. wax aad ku wareersan tahay; aad ka fakarsan tahay. e.g. He is agonizing over how to solve this problem. 2. ciqaab; dilliin xanuun badan. e.g. The jailers agonized the prisoners.
agony: /aagani/agonies; (n) xanuun aad u daran maskaxda ama jirka intiisa kale saameeya (sakaraad).
agree: /agrii/agrees, agreeing, agreed;(v) ku raacid; ku waafiqid. e.g. I agree that it is a good solution.
agreeable: /agriiyabal/ (adj) wax fiican; laysku raaci karo ama macquul ah. e.g. The idea is agreeable to me.
agreement: /agriimant/ (n) heshiis; wax laysla ogolaaday ama laysku raacay. e.g. This agreement should be cancelled.
agriculture: /aagrikaljar/ (n) beer ama cilmiga beeraha. e.g. This area is suitable for agriculture.
aground: /agrowndh/ (adj) quusid; sida markab ama doon_biyo liqeen. e.g. The ship ran aground.
ague: /aajii/ (n) xummadda malaariyada ama qofka kaneecadu cunto.
ah: /aa/ (inter) (informal) haah ama waayahay oo kale ayaa loo isticmaalaa. e.g. Ah, yes, I remember.
aha: /aaha/ (inter) (informal) oraah la isticmaalo markaad wax fahantid ama heshid waxaad raadinaysay. e.g. I had a good book here somewhere. Aha, here we are.
ahead: /aheedh/ (adv) hore, xaga hore, madaxa hore; hor marin. e.g. Look ahead while you are driving.
aid: /eydh/aids, aiding aided;(n) 1. gargaar. e.g. overseas aid for the developing countries. (v) 2. gacan siin, caymin. e.g. She will aid anyone who needs her help.
aide: /eydh/ (n) kaaliye; qofka gof kale shaqaduu qabto ka caawiya.
AIDS: /eeydhis/ cudur dilaa ah oo jirka — ka dhammeeya unugyada gofka ka difaaca cudurada (Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome).
ail: /eeyl/ailing;(v) 1. jirrasho, xanuunsasho. e.g. This medicine is good for what ails you. (v) 2. dhibid, kadeedid. e.g. What ails you?
ailment: /eeylmant/ailments;(n) jirroaim fudud ama xanuun sahlan. e.g. Childern often have minor ailments.
aim: /eeym/aims, aiming, aimed;(v) 1. ujeeddo, muraad, qasdi. e.g. He is aiming to be a doctor. 2. shiishid, ku abbaarid gori ama buntukh. e.g. You should aim your gun at the target.
aimless: /eeymlis/aimlessly;(adj) ujeeddo la'aan, macna darro. e.g. aimless violence.
air: /eer/airs, airing, aired;(n) hawo, hawada sare. e.g. The air temperature is now 60 degrees celsius.
airborne: /eerboorn/ (adj) 1. hawada sare heehaabaya ama bidaya. e.g. The kite was airborne in seconds. 2. hawada sare la xiriira. e.g. airborne troops.
air-conditioned: /eer-kondhishinidh/ (adj) qaboojiye leh; mashiinka hawada qaboojiya leh. e.g. She works in an air-conditioned office.
aircraft: /eerkraft/ (n) | dayuurad, diyaarad. e.g. Two aircraft were shot down in the battle.
aircraft carrier: / aircraft carriers;(n) markabka dagaalka ee diyaaradaha qaada ayna ka duulaan/degaana.
airfield: /eerfiildh/airfields;(n) garoon yar oo diyaaraduhu caga dhigtaan kana duulaan.
air hostess: /eer-hostes/air hostesses;(n) gabar diyaaradda rakaabka saaran u adeegta ama u khidmaysa.
airless: /eerless/ (adj) hawo yar ama neecaw ku filan aan lahayn. e.g. an airless room.
airline: /eerlayn/airlines;(n) shirkad iska leh diyaaradaha dadka qaada. e.g. Saudi Airline is the best airline in the Middle East.
airmail: /eermeyl/ (n) habka warqadaha loogu diro hawada (diyaaradaha iwm) e.g. an airmail envelope.
airplane: /eerpleyn/ (n) diyaarad, (dayuurad). e.g. That was his first flight in an airplane.
airport: /eerpoort/ (n) garoon dayuuradeed, gagi dayuuradeed, ama madaar. e.g. We landed at the airport in London.
air raid: /eer reydh/air raids;(n) diyaarad ku rushayn ama ku dukhayn (ku weerarid).
air terminal: /eerterminal/air terminals;(n) dhismo ama meel dadka diyaaradda raacaya ku nastaan ama ku sii sugaan duulimaadkooda. e.g. The passengers are still waiting in the air terminal.
air traffic control: / (n) dadka ku shaga leh in ay hagaan diyaaradaha, (sida khadkay qaadanayaan iwm).
airwaves: /eerwayvis/ (n) hirarka raadyaha ama T.V. wax u tabiya.
airy: /eeri/ (adj) 1. hawo neecaw badan leh. e.g. an airy theatre. 2. wax aad fududeysatid ama sahlatid. e.g. He greeted him in an airy way.
aisle: /ayal/aisles; (n) dariiq yar oo dhex mara kuraas lugu fariisto oo saf ah ama iskifaale wax la saarto. e.g. Please clear the aisles.
ajar: /ajaar/ (adj) albaab balagan ama in yar ka furan. e.g. She left the door ajar.
akimbo: /akimbo/ (adj) marka qofku gacmaha dhexda ku haysto. e.g. He stood with his arms akimbo.
akin: /akin/ (adj) 1. isku qoys ah, qaraaba ah. 2. wax is shabbaha, isu eg.
alacrity: /alaakrati/ (n) si xiisa leh hawl u qabasho; xamaasad. e.g. The waiter moved with alacrity because he perceived they were big tippers.
a la mode: /alamood/ (adj) habkii ugu dambeeyey u samaysan; noocii ugu dambeeyey; casri ah.
alarm: /alaarm/alarms, alarming, alarmed; (n) 1. qaylo ama shanqar digniin ama baraarujin leh. e.g. The sound of the fire alarm disturbed her. 2. feejignaan welwel leh. e.g. She looked alarmed after the fire.
alarmclock: /alarm_klok/alarm clocks;(n) saacadda dadka hurdada ka toosisa.
alarmist: /alarmist/alarmists;(n) qofkii ama wixii digniin been ah bixiya. e.g. It is not good to be an alarmist.
alas: /alaas/ (inter) haaday (calaamad ama wax cadeynaya murugo, walwal ama shallayto). e.g. There is, alas, a shortage of food in this area.
albatross: /albatroos/albatrosses;(n) 1. shimbir badeed 2. wax ku xayira ama kaa hor istaaga wax aad samayn lahayd.
albeit: /oolbiit/ (conj) hase ahaatee; inkastoo. e.g. There is still a chance, albeit a very small one.
albino: /albayno/albinos; (adj) xayawaan ama qof kulligiis wada cad. e.g. an albino bird.
album: /aalbam/albums;(n) 1. buug masawirada lugu aruuriyo. e.g. My sister has one big album of photographs. 2. saxanka muustikada.
alcohol: /alkahol/ (n) aalkolo. e.g I never drink alcohol.
alcoholic: /alkaholik/alcoholics;(n) aalkoliiste, khamriyacab daran. e.g. He has been an alcoholic for ten years.
alert: /alert/alerts, alerting alerted;(adj) digtoon, feejigan; diyaar ah. e.g. This building has an alert security guard.
algebra: /aaljabra/ (n) xisaabta aljabrada (waxaa la isticmaalaa, xarfo tiro u taagan).
alibi: /aalabaay/alibis;(n) 1. bariinimo (ka maqnaanshaha meel dambi ka dhacay ama lugu galay). e.g. his alibi for the night of the robbery. 2. cududaar, raalli galin khalad dhacay. e.g. He provided no alibi for his absence.
alien: /eyliyan/aliens;(n) laaji, shisheeye ama qof waddan kale u dhashay. e.g. an illegal alien crossing the border.
alienate: /eyliyeneyt/alienates, alienating, alienated;(v) 1. qof aad xumaantiisa raadisid ama ka cadhaysiisid. 2. dad ka go'id ama ka dhex bixid; kali noolaansho.
alight: /alayt/alights, alighting, alighted;(adj) 1. gubanaya, holcaya ama iftiimaya. e.g. This building has been set alight. (v) 2. ka soo dagid baabuur ama tareen oo kale; ka degid. e.g. to alight from a bus.
align: /alaayn/aligns, aligning, aligned;(v) 1. isku saf noqosho ama isku xulufo. 2. saf gelid ama wax simid; isku toosin. (isku hagaajin).
alike: /alayk/ (adj) isu eg. e.g. Twins always look alike.
alimony: /aalamoni/ (n) lacagta ama masruufka loo qoro xaaska markii lays furo. e.g. She receives alimony payments from her ex-husband.
alive: /alayv/ (adj) 1. nool, nolol leh; naf ku jirto. e.g. She told me that her mother is still alive. 2. jiritaan leh, firfircoon.
all: /ool/ kulli, dhammaan. e.g. They are all going to the meeting.
allay: /alleey/allays, allaying, allayed; dejin qof xanaaqsanaa ama cabsanayey (yarayn). e.g. He tried to allay her fears.
allege: /alleej/alleges, alleging, alleged: (v) qgof dambi lugu eedeeyey laakiin aan weli lugu caddayn. e.g. She alleged that he stole the money.
allegiance: /allijans/ (n) daacad u noqosho ama taageersanaan; addeecsanaan. e.g. How can we win the allegiance of the people?
alleluia: /aallaluya/ (inter) erey masiixigu u isticmaalaan inay ilaahooda ugu mahad celiyaan (kaniisadda).
allergic: /allerjik/ (adj) alarjiyo (jirka dadka oo wax qoonsada sida daawada, hawada ama cunto). He is allergic to meat.
allergy: /aallarji/allergies; (n) qofka markii wax gaar ah jirkiisu diido ama uu ku jirrado sida cunta qaarkeed ama daawada. e.g. He has an allergy to milk.
alleviate: /alliiviyeyt/alleviates, alleviating, alleviated; (n) yarayn ama dhimid dhibaato ama xanuun horay u jiray (wax ka qabad). e.g. We want to help alleviate the country's drug problem.
alley: /aalli/alleys; (n) surin; dariiq ama wadiigo yar oo dhismayaal ama meel kale dhex marta.
alliance: /allaayanis/alliances; (n) isbahaysi; gaashaanbuur. e.g. a military alliance.
allied: /allaayid/ (adj) midoobid ama is gaashaan buursi. e.g. allied forces.
alligator: /aallageytar/alligators; (n) bahal weyn oo Maraykanka laga helo oo yaxaaska u eg.
allocate: /aallakeyt/allocates, allocating, allocated, allocation; (v) u qoondayn, u qorshayn ama ugu tala gelid. e.g. This money was allocated for school expenses.
allot: /allat/allots, allotting, allotted; (v) -qayb u siin; u qorshayn, u xaddidid. e.g. A fixed time is allotted for each person.
allotment: /allatment/allotments; (n) 1. qayb u helid 2. dhul yar oo wax lugu beerto.
allow: /allaw/allows, allowing, allowed; (v) u ogolaansho ama u fasixid. e.g. We decided not to allow smoking.
allowable: /allawabal/ (adj) wax la fasaxay ama faraha laga qaaday, la ogolaaday.
allowance: /allawansi/allowances; (n) lacag luguu siiyo arin darteed, gunno. e.g. the family allowance for single mothers.
all right: /ool rayt/ (adj) 1. hagaagsan ama macquul ah; fiicnaan. e.g. She was feeling sick, but she is all right now. 2. waa hagaag ama waa “okey” All right, what is next?
all-round: /ool-rawnd/ (adj) all-rounder, all-rounders; qof waxyaala badan ku fiican; xirfado badan yaqaan. e.g. an all-round student.
allude: /alluudh/alludes, alluding, alluded; (v) hadal maldihid ama sarbeebid; dul marid.
allure: /alluur/alluring; (n) wax ku soo jiita ama ku xiisa galiya. e.g. the allure of gold and jewels.
allusion: /alluushan/allusions; (n) si dadban wax ugu sheegid ama u dulmarid.
ally: /allaay/allies, allying allied; (v) is bahaysi, isku dad ama isku koox. e.g. our courageous ally.
almighty: /oolmayti/ (adj) awood oo dhan leh; lahaansho aan qiyaas lahayn (magac kale oo ilaah loo yaqaan). e.g. the mercy of the almighty God.
almost: /oolmoost/ (adv) ku dhawaad; ku sigtay; qiyaastil. e.g. Aways spent almost four years in Harlem.
aloft: /alooft/ (adv) wax kor u kacsan ama hawada sare ku laalan (jira). e.g. balloons flying aloft.
alone: /aloon/ (adv) keli ama keli ahaansho. e.g. She wanted to be alone.
along: /aloog/ (prep) 1. dhinac socda ama la bar-bar ah. e.g. along the river side. (adv) 2. wehelin, la socosho. e.g. Ali walked to school along with his friends. 3. dhanka hore (horay).
alongside: /aloongsayd/ (prep) 1. dhinaca isku haya; dhinac socda. e.g. There was a bookstore alongside the theatre. 2. gacmaha is haysta ama iscaawinaya (isla shaqayn kara).
aloof: /aluuf/aloofly, aloofness; (adv) 1. ka yara fog ama ka durugsan. e.g. He stands aloof from other people. (adj) 2. qof xirxiran ama dabeecad qallafsan. e.g. She has an aloof personality.
aloud: /alawdh/ (adv) hadal ku dhawaaqid; kor u dhihid. e.g. You should not speak aloud in public.
alphabetical: /aalfabetikal/alphabetically; (adj) wax laysugu xijiyo sida xarfuhu isugu xigaan. e.g. The words were arranged in alphabetical order.
alpine: /aalpayn/ (adj) 1. wax buuraha dhaadheer ku lug leh 2. dhirta buuraha dushooda ka baxda.
already: /oolredhi/ (adv) mar hore, durbaba (jaa). e.g. She had already left.
also: /oolso/ (adv) waliba ama sidokale; isla markaasna. e.g. Her name is also Deeqa.
alter: /ooltar/alters, altering; altered, alteration; (v) badelid ama isbadelid; wax ka bedelid.
altercation: /ooltarkeyshan/ (n) isku qaylin, ilaaqtan, muran qayla badan leh.
alternative: /oolternativ/alternatively; (adj) wax bedeli kara wax kale ama badal u nogon kara. e.g. People are still looking for an alternative solution.
although: /ooldoo/ (conj) inkastoo. e.g. Although I am sick, I have to go to work.
altitude: /aaltatiyuud/ (n) sare ama sarreeya marka badda laga cabbiro. e.g. Airplanes fly at high altitudes.
altogether: /ooltugethar/ (adv) wadajir, dhammaamba, gabiba, kulligoodba; guud ahaan. e.g. I will get $400 a week altogether.
altruism: /altrusam/altruistic; (n) qof aan danayste ahayn ama dadka si daacad ah ula dhaqma; dadka u roon. e.g. His altruism was well-known in the community.
aluminium: /alyuminiyam/ (n) jaandi; macdan bir ah oo laga sameeyo dhariyaasha, fiilooyinka korontada, dayactirka diyaaradaha iwm. e.g. an aluminium frying pan.
always: /oolweys/ (adv) had iyo jeer; mar kasta. e.g. I always go to the library.

amass: /amaas/amasses, amassing, amassed; (v) isku rasayn ama isku ururin. e.g. When she amassed enough money, she decided to open a business.
amateur: /aamajar/ (n) 1. qofka ciyaar(isboorti) ama hawl kale hiwaayadahaan u qabta 2. gof barbarad ah(khibrad aan lahayn).

amazement: /ameeysment/ (n) amakaag; u qaadan waa; cajaa'ib. e.g. Ali stood up in amazement.

amber: /aambar/ (n) 1. canbar (bir jaalle iyo maroon isku jir ah oo laga sameeyo luulka). e.g. a dark amber ring 2. midabka huruudda ama jaallaha ah. e.g. The traffic lights continuously switch from green to amber and then red.
ambience: /ambiyens/ (n) bay'ada aad ku nooshahay; hab nololeed ka aad ku dhex jirtid.
ambiguity: /aambagyuwati/ambiguities; (adj) macna badan leh; aan la hubin macnaha, siyaalo badan loo fasiri karo. e.g. There are many ambiguities and contradictions in his speech.
ambiguous: /ambigyuwas/ambiguously; (adj) hadal siyaaba badan loo fahmi karo ama aan caddayn; aan macna sugan lahayn. e.g. The meaning of the story was ambiguous .
ambition: /aambishan/ambitions; (n) hammad, hiyi, laab ku hayn; ku fakarid, higsasho. e.g. My ambition is to be a doctor.

amble: /aambal/ambles, ambling; ambled; (v) laafyood, si raaxa leh u socosho, si dhib yar u socosho ama xarraga leh. e.g. She ambled home through the village.
ambulance: /aambiyalans/ (n) baabuurka gqafilan ee lugu qaado dhaawaca; aanbalaas.
ambush: /aambush/ambushes; ambushing, ambushed; (v) gaadid, (weerar kadis ah ama dhabar jabin). e.g. The enemy was successfully ambushed and defeated.
amen: /eymen/ (inter) kalmad la macna ah aammiin oo dadka masiixiga ah yiraahdaan markey ducaysanayaan. e.g. Everyone said amen after the prayer.
amenable: /aminabal/amenably; (adj) loo riyaaqi karo, la ogolaan karo ama macquul ah. e.g. My son was amenable to whatever I said.

amendment: /amendhment/amendments; (n) sixid ama hagaajin; wax ku darid ama wax ka badelid qoraal hore ama sharci qornaa. e.g. We made a few amendments to the agreement before signing it.
amenity: /amenati/amenities; (n) meel ama wax lugu raaxo qaato, sida garoon ciyaareed, baar, barkad dabaal iwm e.g. Luxury hotels offer amenities for relaxation and enjoyment.

We need a new approach to this problem.

architect: /arkatekt/ (n) 1. qofka sawira naqshadaha dhismayaasha. e.g. He is a great architect. 2. qofka wax soo saara, abuura ama sabab u noqda in waxaasi dhacaan. e.g. He was the real architect of modern arts.
