aspirin: /aaspirin/aspirins; (n) aasbiriin (kiniini madaxa u roon). e.g. My doctor gave me an aspirin for my headache.
ass: /aas/asses; (n) 1. dameer 2. qofka edebta xun ama axmagqa ah. (infl) 3. futada.
assail: /asseeyl/assails, assailing, assailed; (v) 1. cay aad u daran ama cambaarayn, 2. weerarid si rabsha leh, 3. musiibo (dhibaato badan oo hal mar ku haleesha).
assailant: /asseylant/assailants; (n) qofka shirqool ku dila qof kale (gacan ku dhiigle).
assassinate: /assaasaneyt/assassinates, assassinating, assassinated; (v) dilid ama shirqoolid gof muhiim ah (madax ah).
assassination: /assaasaneyshan/ (n) shirqool u dhigid, khiddad ku dilid. e.g. an assassination carried out by a hired killer.
assault: /assoolt/assaults, assaulting, assaulted; (n) 1. weerar kadis ah oo xoog leh. e.g. Our army responded with an assault against the enemy's position. (v) 2. gardaro ku weerarid, af ama addin ~ ku xadgudbid. e.g. He was accused of assaulting his brother. 3. fara-xumayn..e.g. The man was found guilty of making an assault on his stepdaughter.
assemble: /assembal/assembles, assembling, assembled; (v) 1. isku ururid ama isu tagid. e.g. The Arab leaders assembled in Cairo for an emergency meeting. 2. isku xirxirid ama isku rakibid. e.g. This automobile was assembled locally.
assembly: /assembali/assemblies; (n) 1. kulan weyn ama isku ururid. e.g. The Assembly of African-American People in Canada. 2. gole ama guddi loo xilsaaray hawl gaar ah sida sharci dejinta. e.g. The United Nations General Assembly. 3. isku xirxirid ama isku duwid. e.g. the assembly of the parts of an automobile.
assembly line: / assembly lines; (n) nidaamka warshadaha ee qof walba iyo mashiin walba shaqada qaar qabto (qofba gof u dhiibo ama mashiinba mashiin). e.g. She spends eight hours a day on an assembly line.
assent: /assent/assents, assenting, assented; (v) ku raacid ama u ogolaansho sharci, fikrad iwm. e.g. — The general manager did not give his assent of the proposal.
assert: /assert/asserts, asserting, asserted; (v) 1. caddayn ama carabka ku adkayn (si cad u sheegid) 2. qof awooddiisa dadka tusa ama soo bandhiga awooddiisa (isticmaala) 3. ku adkaysasho, ama caddaysasho fikrad, xuquuq iwm. e.g. She asserted that she was innocent.
assertion: /assershan/assertions; (n) 1. caddayn, xaqiiq (si cad u qeexid) 2. awood ama xukun adeegsasho (isticmaalid).
assertive: /assertiv/assertively; (adj) 1. qof ku adag fikradiisa (ma hare) ma quuste. e.g. Ali is an assertive boy, with an opinion on everything. 2. hadal cad (qeexan). e.g. an assertive sentence.
assess: /asses/assesses, assessing, assessed; (v) qumeyn. e.g. I asked her to assess the market value of my house. They met to assess the idea of establishing a community centre.
assessment: /assesmant/assessments; (n) qiimeyn gof, shay (wax) ama xaalad. e.g. We need to have a clear assessment of the situation.
asset: /aasset/assets; (n) 1. raasumaal; wax qiima leh oo aad leedahay. e.g. I have no personal assets. 2. qof ama wax qiimo iyo qaayo ku fadhiya. e.g. Two years experience is an asset for this job.
assiduous: /assiijuwas/ (adj) shago u hagar bixid ama u go'doomid (hawl karnimo). e.g. an assiduous worker.
assign: /assaayn/assigns, assigning, assigned; (v) 1. qof hawl gaar ah lugu qaybiyo (loo diro). e.g. She had been assigned to clean the house. 2. loo qoondeeyo ama loo xilsaaro. e.g. I was assigned a comfortable office to work in.
assignation: /assignayshan/assignations; (n) kulan garsoodi ah, sida gabar iyo wiil is jecel.
assignment: /assaaynment/ (n) 1. shaqo lugugu qaybiyo ama luguu xilsaaro in aad fuliso (qabato). e.g. My first assignment was to assess the company's tangible assets. 2. shaqa guri. e.g. Our teacher gave us a math assignment.
assimilate: /assimaleyt/assimilates, assimilating, assimilated; (v) 1. wax ama fikrad aad si fiican u fahantid ama u dhuuxdid. e.g. Sarah reads many books to assimilate more knowledge. 2. la qabsasho, dhexgelid ama ku milmid dad cusub oo kale sida qaxootiga markay la qabsadaan waddankay tagaan. e.g. Canada has assimilated a lot of people from all over the world.
assist: /assist/assists, assisting, assisted; (v) caawin ama gargaarid (gacan siin). e.g. He assists his son with payment of tuition fee.
assistance: /assistans/ (n) caawimaad ama gargaar. e.g. She thanked me for my assistance.
assistant: /assistant/assistants; (adj) kaaliye ama caawiye. e.g. He is an assistant manager.
associate: /assooshiyeyt/associates, associated, associating; (v) 1. isku xirid ama isu keenid laba qof ama laba shay. e.g. Christians associate giving presents with Christmas. 2. isku xirnaan ama isku koox (isu urur) noqosho. e.g. He is associated with a law firm. 3. rafiiq la noqosho (saaxiib ka dhigasho). e.g. Do not associate with bad boys. (adj) 4. xubin aan xuquuq buuxda lahayn. e.g. He is an associate member.
association: /assoosiyeyshan/associations; (n) 1. urur hal ujeeddo wada leh 2. xiriir, isku xirnaan, ku lug lahaan. e.g. He has ended his association with that company.
assorted: /assoortidh/assortment;(adj) kala nooc-nooc ah; kala du-duwan. e.g. a bag of assorted candies.
assume: /assiyuum/assumes, assuming, assumed; (v) 1. u qaadasho ama u fakarid (u malayn). e.g. He assumed that the bus would be on time. 2. mas'uuliyad qaadid (xukun qaadid). e.g. He assumed power in 1960.
assumption: /asampshan/ (n) 1. malayn; si u qaadasho. e.g. He made a false assumption. 2. xukun la wareegid.
assurance: /ashuuransi/ (n) 1. ballanqaad. e.g. He gave his assurance that the problem would be corrected. 2. kalsooni. e.g. She spoke with assurance. 3. caymis.
assure: /ashuur/assures, assuring, assured; (v) 1. ballanqaadid ama hubanti bixin. e.g. This car is in good condition, I can assure you.
assuredly: /ashuuridhli/ (adv) hubaashii ama xaqiiq ahaan. e.g. He would assuredly be back in two weeks.
astonish: /astonish/astonishes, astonished, astonishing; (v) aad u yaabid (amakaagid), yaab leh. e.g. She is astonished that I can do this job.
astonishment: /astonishmant/ (n) yaab, amakaag. e.g. He looked at him with astonishment.
astound: /astawndh/astounds, astounding astounded; (v) la yaabid ama u qaadan waa (wax aad la yaabtid lama filaana kugu noqday). e.g. We were astounded that such a thing could happen.
astray: /astrey/ (adv) marin habaabsan, waddada saxda ah ka weecsan. e.g. He is my best friend; he won't lead me astray.
astride: /astraydh/ (prep) lugaha ka kala ridasho ama kala fogayn sida fardo fuulka. e.g. I like to ride my horse astride.
astringent: /astirinjant/ (n) 1. dhiig-joojiye ama wax jirka qalajiya. (adj) 2. wax ama qof aad dhaleecaysid (cambaaraysid). e.g. He directed his most astringent attacks at me.
astrologer: /astrolajar/astrologers; (n) faaliye ama qof wax-sheega. e.g. I will never go to astrologers again; they are liars.
astrology: /astrolaji/astrological; (n) cilmi falaga (xiddigaha oo laga faaliyo). e.g. Some people still believe in astrology.
astronaut: /astranoot/astronauts; (n) cir bixiyeen ama qof u tababaran dayax gacmeed wadid ama raacid.
astronomer: /astroonamar/astronomers; (n) gofka ku takhasusa cilmiga xiddigiska iyo meerayaasha sare.
astronomical: /astranamikal/ (adj) 1. wax xaddi badan ama sicir cirka ku shareeran (badan). e.g. an astronomical price 2. wax ku lug leh cilmiga xiddigiska.
astronomy: /astraanami/ (n) cilmiga xiddigiska ama meerayaasha sare. e.g. He studied astronomy.
astute: /astiyuut/astutely; (v) qof maskax badan (qof ku wanaagsan ~ fahmidda dabeecadaha iyo xaaladaha adag, ama xariif ku ah). e.g. He is an astute politician.
asylum: /asaaylam/asylums; (n) 1. magan-galyo siyaasadeed (magan-galyo siin). e.g. There are more refugees in the world seeking political asylum. 2. meesha dadka © waalan lugu xannaaneeyo. (maanakoobiyo).
asymmetrical: /asimmatrikal/ (adj) wax ama shay laba qaybood ama laba dhinac oo kala duwan (kala gadisan) leh.
ate: /eyt/ (v) waa cunay (eat oo fal tagay ah). e.g. I ate my lunch already.
atheist: /eythiyist/atheists; (n) diin laawe ama mulxid (ilaah inkirsan). e.g. Do not quarrel about religion with an atheist.
athlete: /athlit/athletes; (n) ciyaar yahan ka qayb qaata tartamada ciyaaraha fudud sida orodada, boodada iwm. e.g. Abdi Bile is a great athlete.
athletic: /athletik/athletics; (adj) 1. ciyaaraha fudud oo ay ka mid yihiin orodka, boodada, qaalma-rogadka iwm. e.g. An athletics competition will be held in Tokyo next year. 2. jir dhisan leh.
atlas: /aatlas/atlases; (n) buug maab ku sawiran yahay (buug joqoraafi meel leedahay lugu sawiro sida joqoraafiga magaalo ama waddan).
atmosphere: /aatmasfeer/atmospheres; (n) 1. hawada dhulka dushiisa ama hawada dhulka ku xeeran. 2. beey'ad ama jawi. e.g. We met in a quiet atmosphere.
atom: /aatam/ (n) 1. saxarka ugu yar ee maatarku ka samaysan yahay ee aan lasii qaybqaybin karin (proton + neutrons + electron) 2. wax aad u yar ama saxar le'eg (ciddi jabkeed). e.g. There's not one atom of truth in what he said.
atom bomb: / (n) atom bombs, atomic bomb; hub aad halis u ah oo laga sameeyo awoodda atamka.
atomic: /aatomik/ (adj) 1. wax ku shaqa leh quwadda atamka 2. la xiriira qaybaha atamku ka kooban yahay (mulukuyuulada atamka) ama atamka laftiisa. e.g. atomic weapons.
atone: /atoon/atones, atoning, atoned; (v) raalli gelin ama dib isu sixid. e.g. Ahmed atoned for his unkindness to Sarah by taking her to the restaurant.
atrocious: /atrooshas/atrociously; (adj) 1. aad u xun ama aad u tayo daran. 2. wax aad u xun oo laga walaaco ama naxdin leh. e.g. His manners are atrocious.
atrocity: /atrosati/atrocities; (n) fal aad u xun oo naxariis darro ah.
attach: /attaaj/attaches, attaching, attached; (v) 1. ku xirid ama ku dhejin; ku xidhnaan. e.g. He attached a note to my letter. 2. ka tirsanaan shirkad, hay'ad iwm. e.g. This Institute is attached to the University of California. 3. la wareegid si sharci ah. e.g. All his properties may be attached by the government. 4. xiriir qota-dheer la yeelasho, aad ula saaxiibid. e.g. He is deeply attached to her.
attache: /attaajee/attaches; (n) 1. ku-qaybsane-safaaradeed. (xubin ku qaybsan hawl gaar ah oo safaaradeed). e.g. He was a military attache at the Somali embassy in Paris.
attache case: / attache cases; (n) samsonayt, shandad yar ama boorso yar oo afar gees ah.
attachment: /attaajmant/ (n) 1. xiriir ama saaxiibtinimo weyn, isjeclaan ama is-addeecsanaan. 2. isku xidhid ama bir wax lugu xidho.
attack: /attaak/attacks, attacking, attacked; (v) 1. weerarid, weerar. e.g. She was attacked by an armed man. 2. dagaal afka ah oo kul-kulul ama qoraal ah. e.g. There was an article in the newspaper which attacks government policies.
attacker: /attaakar/attackers; (n) qofka ama cidda wax weerarta (weerar qaade). e.g. She could not remember what the attacker looked like.
attain: /atteyn/attains, attaining, attained; (v) wax aad heshid ama aad gaartid dadaal badan kadib. e.g. He worked hard to attain his ambitions.
attainable: /atteynabal/ attainment; (n) wax la gaari karo, la heli karo ama la samayn karo.
attempt: /attempt/attempts, attempting, attempted; (v) isku dayid ama tijaabin. e.g. He attempted to pass this exam two times.
attempted: /attempted/ (adj) dambi aad isku dayday oo kaa dhicisoobay. e.g. She was charged with attempted murder.
attend: /attendh/attends, attending, attended; (v) 1. ka qaybgalid (ka xaadirid). e.g. He attends a meeting every day. 2. iskuul galid, iskuul dhigasho. e.g. I attend City College of New York. 3. wax aad si taxadar leh u dhegaysatid ama u qabatid (digtooni leh). e.g. Everyone has to attend to his duty.
attendance: /attendhansi/attendances; (n) ka qayb gelitaan ama xaadirid, joogid. e.g. Attendance is a must at school.
attendant: /attendhant/attendants; (n) 1. qof shaqadiisu tahay inuu dadka (kalyantiga) u khidmeeyo (u shaqeeyo) sida shubaha baasiinka. e.g. He works as an attendant at the gas station. 2. wax kale ku lug leh ama la xiriira.
attention: /attenshan/attentions; (n) digtooni, feejignaan, wax aad si taxadar leh u dhagaysatid, u eegtid ama u samaysid. e.g. She was listening to her mother with close attention.
attentive: /attentiv/attentively; (adj) qof feejigan ama digtoon (maskaxdiisu soo jeeddo). e.g. He is a very attentive student.
attest: /attest/attests, attesting, attested; (v) la xaqiijiyo ama la caddeeyo (xaqiijin).
attic: /aattik/attics; (n) qol ama meel yar oo guriga saqafkiisa laga hoos dhiso oo marmar wax lugu xafido.
attire: /attaayar/attired; (n) dhar, labbis ama dhar xidhasho. e.g. She was dressed in formal attire.
attitude: /attatiyuud/attitudes; (n) 1. siyaabaha qof u dhaqmo ama wax u arko (u fakaro). e.g. I don't like her attitude. 2. qaabka ama sida jirka xubin ka mid ah laga dhigo eg. with his arms flung out in an attitude of surrender.
attract: /attraakt/attracts, attracting, attracted; (v) wax soo jiidasho leh, ku soo jiita ama ku xiiso geliya (sida bir-labta ku soo jiita). e.g. Her appearance did not attract me.
attractions: /attraakshan/attractions; (n) isa-soo jiidasho sida bir-lab oo kale; qof ama wax soo-jiidasho leh ama la caashiqi karo (jinni leh). e.g. Kenya has tourist attractions.
attractive: /attraakitiv/ (adj) wax ku soo-jiidanaya (aad jecleysanayso). e.g. She wore an attractive t-shirt. She is a very attractive young girl.
attribute: /attrabiyuut/attributes, attributing, attributed; (v) 1. sabab u ah ama loo aanaynayo (wax sabab u ah dhacdo ama xaalad). e.g. Some people attribute their success to luck. 2. u aqoonsasho (in qof ama wax, loo aqoonsado wax uu sameeyey, abuuray, helay iwm) 3. sifo (tilmaan). e.g. his physical attributes.
attuned: /atiyuundh/ (adj) 1. la qabsasho — ama u barasho 2. wax maqalkoodu kaa bato ama cod dhagahaagu qabatimaan.
auburn: /oobaran/ (adj) timo kafee ah 0O casaan xiga (guduud iyo kafee isku jira). e.g. I like her auburn hair.
auction: /ookshan/auctions, auctioning, auctioned; (v) 1. xaraashid; (n) 2.auction off xaraash. e.g. I bought my car at an auction.
auction off: / (phr) xaraashid ama sicir jaban ku gadid (ku khaarajin). e.g. All my books were auctioned off.
audacious: /oodheyshas/audaciously, audacity; (adj) 1. indha-adayg ama qof ku dhiirran wax khasaaro uga imaan karto; 2. af-adayg iyo edeb darro.
audible: /oodhabal/audibly; (adj) la maqli karo (cod ama shanqadh dheer ilaa heer la maqli karo). e.g. She spoke in an audible voice.
audience: /oodhiyansi/audiences; (n) dhagayste (sida qof wax daawanaya isla markaasna dhagaysanaya). e.g. The concert attracted a large audience.
audio: /oodhiyo/ (adj) 1. magal la xiriira 2. qalabka wax lugu dhegeysto, luguna duubo. e.g. An audio problem is a sound problem.
audio-typist: / audio-typists; (n) qofka garaaca war cajalad lugu duubay.
audit: /oodhit/audits, auditing, audited; (v) xisaab hubin. (ama xisaabi xil maleh samayn) ; jeegarayn in si sax ah wax loo xisaabay. e.g. I am expecting to be audited this year.
auditor: /oodhitar/ (n) hanti-dhowr ama xisaabiye dabagala ama hubiya in si sax ah wax loo xisaabay. e.g. Once a year an auditor comes to verify the business accounts.
auditorium: /oodhatooriyam/auditoriums (n) 1. meesha ay dhagaystayaashu fariistaan masraxa gudihiisa (fadhi) 2. tiyaatar ama dhismo weyn oo loogu talagalay shirarka ama riwaayadaha. e.g The National Theatre in Somalia had a beautiful auditorium.
auger: /oogar/ (v) galab looxaanta ama dhulka lugu duleeliyo.
augment: /oogment/augments, augmenting, augmented; (v) siyaadin, kordhin ama weeynayn. e.g. She had to augment her income by working seven days a week.
augur: /oogar/augurs, auguring, augured; (v) 1. calaamad ama wax kuu saraadiya wax xun ama wax fiican (jirro ama caafimaad). e.g. A long drought doesn't augur well for a good harvest. 2. qof wax-sheega (faaliya in qof guulaysanayo ama khasaarayo).
August: 1. /oogast/august; (n) bisha siddeedaad ee miilaadiga. e.g. I started this job in August.
august: /oogast/ (n) qof ama shay heer sare ah oo laga danbeeyo (la qadariyo).
aunt: /aant/aunts; (n) eeddo ama habar-yar. e.g. She is my aunt.
au pair: /ow peer/ au pairs; (n) ilmo ama qof dhalin yaro ah oo reer korsado, lugqadana ka barta una shaqeeya (badanaa ajnabi ah). e.g. An au pair from Montreal is living with my family here in Toronto.
aural: /ooral/ (adj) maqal ah (wax maqal ku lug leh). e.g. I must have an aural test done at the doctor's office.
auspice: /oospasis/auspices; (n) hoggaamin ama maamulid; badrooninimo. e.g. an emergency meeting was held under the auspices of the United Nations.
auspicious: /oosbishas/auspiciously; (adj) 1. arrin guul u dhow ama u eg in lugu guuleysanayo (guul saraadin) 2. barwaaqo.
austere: /oosteer/austerity; (adj) 1. wax cad oo aan sharraxaad lahayn sida derbi cad oo kale. e.g. Her room is sober and austere. 2. qof ad-adag ama si xirxiran u nool; nolol heer hoose ah oo aan raaxo lahayn. e.g. His father was a silent and austere man.
Australian: /oostreliyan/ (adj) qof Ustereeliya u dhashay ama shay lugu sameeyey. e.g. My teacher has lived in an Australian city.
authentic: /oothentik/authenticity; (adj) 1. shay ama qoraal asal ah (rasmi ah) (aan koobbi iyo sanifaad midna ahayn). e.g. We have to check if this is an authentic signature. 2. war ama arrin sax ah oo lugu kalsoonaan karo. e.g. authentic Somali culture.
authenticate: /oothentikeyt/ authenticates, authenticating, authenticated; (v) 1. wax la baaray oo la xaqiijiyey inuu run yahay (tasdiiqin). e.g. The news report has to be authenticated before it is released.
author: /oothar/authors; (n) qoraa (qofka wax qora). e.g. Abdullahi is the author of the novel, Ayaan-Daran.
authoritarian: /athoorateeriyan/authoritarians; (adj) kaligi-taliye ama kali-talin. e.g. Some South African governments remain authoritarian.
authoritative: /athoorateytiv/authoritatively; (adj) 1. awood xukun leh; awood maamul leh. 2. cilmi u leh (aqoon fiican u leh maaddo gaar ah). e.g. Authoritative orders came from the commander.
authority: /athoorati/authorities; (n) 1. awood ama xukun; dawlad ama qof dawlad ka socda. e.g. A lot of employees are under his authority. 2. aqoon fiican u yeelasho cilmi gaar ah. e.g. She is an authority on African history.
authorize: /ootharays/authorises, authorizing, authorized; (v) amar ku bixin (ogolaansho) yeelid. e.g. The President authorized him to visit to United States.
authorization: /ootharaseyshan/ (n) ogolaansho rasmi ah ama amar bixin (sida badan waxyaabaha qoran oo saxiixa lugu ogolaado). e.g. You can't have a loan without official authorization from the bank manager.
autobiographical: /ootabay-graafikal/ (adj) goraal la xiriira qoraha taariikh nololeedkiisa.
autobiography: /ootabayagrafi/autobiographies; (n) qof taariikh nololeedkiis uu asagu goro.
autocracy: /ootakrasi/ (n) kali-talin (in qof kaliya taliyo), kali xukumid.
autograph: /ootograaf/autographs, autographing, autographed; (n) qof caan ah saxiixiis. e.g. I have Mohamed Ali's autograph.
automate: /ootameyt/automates, automating, automated; (v) qalab ama wax iskii isu wada (ootomaatik) (aalad is wadda). e.g. Fewer employees are needed in a factory when it is automated.
automatic: /ootamatik/automatics, automatically; (adj) 1. mashiin is wadda ama qalab kale oo si otomaatik ah u shaqeeya. e.g. an automatic machine 2. fal qofka ka dhaca ama uu sameeyo asagoon ka fakarin ama uusan shago ku lahayn. e.g. She gave me an automatic response.
automation: /ootameyshan/automatons; (n) qalab gof oo kale ah (sidii gof u adeega). e.g The time is approaching when human workers may be replaced by automation.
automobile: /ootamobil/automobiles; (n) gaari (baabuur). e.g. Leaning to drive an automobile requires patience.
autonomous: /ootanamas/ autonomy; (adj) madax-bannaani ama qolo iskeed isu xukunta (sida shirkad is-xukunta).
autopsy: /ootapsi/autopsies; (n) baaris lagu ogaado gof sababta iyo siduu u dhintay.
autumn: /ootam/autumns. (n) xilliga ama fasalka dayrta. e.g. I will be going to London this autumn.
auxiliary: /oogsilyari/auxiliaries; (n) 1. caawiye (gargaare); taageero leh. e.g. a nursing auxiliary (adj) 2. siyaado ah ama markii loo baahdo la isticmaalo.
avail: /aveyl/avails, availing, availed; (v) 1. wax ku anfaca ama faa'iido kuu leh. 2. ka faa'tideysi. e.g. Money will not avail you after you are dead.
available: /aveeylabal/availability; (adj) wax ama qof la heli karo (diyaar ah). e.g. There is no money available at this moment.
avalanche: /aavalaanj/avalanches; (n) 1. barafka buuraha geesohooda ka soo daata (baraf badan oo buur hoosteed yaala). e.g. A group of skiers was buried under an avalanche. 2. wax tiro badan oo hal mar kulma (wax xaddi badan sida daadka). e.g. He fielded an avalanche of questions from the students.
avant-garde: /avantgardh/ (adj) aad u hormarsan (aad casri u ah). e.g an avant-garde sculpture.
avarice: /aavaris/ (n) hunguri weyni xaga lacagta, maalka (dhuuninimo ama damac badni).
avaricious: /avaarishas/ (adj) qofka hunguriga weyn ama damaca badan (dhuuniga ah) xaga maalka/lacagta.

aware: /aweer/ (adj) 1. aqoonsanaan, yaqiinsanaan, (wax aad dareensantahay). e.g. |am fully aware of my responsibilities. 2. ogaan, ka war-hayn (wax aad ogtahay). e.g. I was not aware of this news.

hydrofoil: /hydrofoyl/ (n) doon-weyn oo lugo biyaha dhex-gala leh.
hydrophobia: /hydrofobiya/ (n) 1. cudur xoolaha ku dhaca oo waala. (n) 2. cabsi ama biinan ka-qabista biyaha.
hygienic: /hayjenik/ (adj) 1. caafimaad-wanaag keenaya (caafimaad leh). e.g. hygienic conditions. (adj) 2. nadiif (nadaafad-leh.
hymn: /him/ (n) qasiido ama hees diini ah, siiba xamdi-naq eebbe ah.
hypnosis: /hipnowsis/ (n) maddiiddo (waxyaabo qofka lugu sameeyo oo qofka ka dhiga qof wax kasta oo la doonayo la yeelsiiyo).
hypnotize: /hipnatayz/ (v) maddiiddayn. e.g. I was able to hypnotize her into doing things against her own will.
hypodermic: /haypadermik/ (adj) loo adeegsado ama la-xiriira duridda, sida silingaha iwm.
hypothetical: /haypothetikal/ (adj) mala-abaar ah (ka-soo qaad ah ama ku-salaysan aragti-qiyaaseed). e.g. I don't see the point in discussing hypothetical situations; That situation is completely hypthetical.
hysteria: /histeriya/ (n) 1. kac-sanaanta xididada-maskaxda ama shoogsanaanta qofka (n) 2. kac-sanaanta dad-badan, siiba xad-dhaaf ah. e.g. The current hysteria about the shortage of food is getting worse.
I,i: /ay/ (pron) 1. aniga. 2. xarafka sagaalaad ee alifbeetada ingiriisiga.
ibis: /aybis/ (n) shimbir weyn oo laga helo meelaha biyo galeenka ah iyo cimilada kulul.
ice: /ays/ (n) baraf (biyo fadhiya). e.g. Could you give me a cup of water with ice?
iceberg: /aysberg/ (n) jabal ama dhadhaab weyn oo baraf ah oo badda ka samaysma (jabal baraf ah).
icicle: /aysikal/ (n) barafka usha oo kale ah oo ka soo laalaada saqafka ama darbiyada, xilliga qaboobaha
icing: /aysin/ (n) iskujir ka kooban, bur, sonkor iyo ukun oo dusha looga qurxiyo doolshaha am keegga. My mother put icing on his birthday cake.
icy: /aysi/ (adj) wax baraf leh ama saa'id u qabow. e.g. Icy roads are dangerous.
ID: /aydhii/ (abbr) aqoonsi (identification, oo la soo gaabiyey). e.g. Before we cash this check we need two pieces of ID.
i'd/: (abbr) 'I had' ama 'I would', 'I should', 'I could' oo la soo gaabiyey. e.g. I'd rather stay home today.
idea: /aydhiya/ (n) fikrad ama ra'yi. e.g. Everyone has his own idea. He has very strict ideas about law.
ideal: /aydhiyal/ (adj) 1. horyaal ah, aad u fiican ama aad u habboon. e.g. an ideal school 2. wax ku dayasho mudan (tusaale noqon kara) sida qof fikradihiis; fikrad sare. e.g. She is the ideal person for this position.
idealism: /aydhiyalism/ (n) fikrad ku salaysan in wax kasta horyaal noqdo ama heer sare. e.g. the idealism of the young generation.
idealist: /aydhiyalist/ (n) tusaale sare oo khayaali ah. (falsafadda iwm) ~ fikrad sare oo khayaali ah aaminsan.
idealize: /aydhiyalays/ (v) u fakarid ama u sawirasho in wax sida ay yihiin ay ka sarreeyaan.
ideally: /aydhiyali/ (adv) sida ugu sarraysa ee wax noqon karaan (sida ugu fiican ama ugu habboon). e.g. Ideally, I would like to be a millionaire.
identical: /aydhentikal/ (adj) isku mid (wax meel kasta isaga eg). e.g. They are identical twins.
identification: /aydhentafakayshan/ (n) 1. aqoonsi. e.g. The only identification that I have is my passport. 2. qof in la sugo qofkuu yahay. e.g. Identification of the body will take time.
identify: /aydhentafay/ (v) aqoonsiin (muujin ama caddayn aqoonsi). e.g. He has no ID to identify himself.
ideology: /aydhiyolaji/ (n) ideologies, aydhiyoolojiyad (caqiido, garaad siyaasadeed ama mid bulsho). e.g. Socialist ideology.
idiocy: /aydhiyasi/ idiocies;(n) wax aad u foolxun oo doqonimo ah.
idiom: /idhiyam/ (n) sarbeeb (hadal maldahan ama macna kale laga wado).
idiot: /idhiyat/ (n) qalbi daciif ama nacas. e.g. He is an idiot.
idle: /aydhal/ (adj) idles, idling, idled; 1. shaqa la'aan, dhaqdhaqaaq darro. e.g. He was idle while the machines were down. 2. qof caajiska ah. 3. wax macna darro loo qabto ama aan ujeeddo laga lahayn. e.g. Her idle chatter was annoying.
idol: /aydhol/idols;(n) 1. sanam, (ama ilaah been ah oo gacanta lugu sameeyo) e.g. They made stone idols to worship. 2. qof aad looga daba dhaco ilaa heer laga dambeeyo. e.g. That singer is the idol of many young people.
idyll: /aydhil/idylls, idyllic; (adj) meel farxad iyo baraare loogu nool yahay sida nolosha baadiyaha ee fudud. e.g. It is an idyllic place to live.
if: /if/ (conj) 1. haddii (shardi). e.g. I will give you some money if you give me this book. 2. haddaad (ka soo qaad). e.g. You can buy this T.V. if you have enough money. 3. kolkii (haddaadan, haddaysan). e.g. If I'm not here you can smoke.
iffy: /ifi/ (adj) aan la hubin, shaki uu ku jiro (wax laba-labo ku jirto). e.g. He was very iffy about what to do.
ignite: /ignayt/ ignites, igniting, ignited; (v) shidid, daarid, hurin. e.g. The wood will not ignite easily because it is wet.
ignition: /ignishan/ (n) matoorka meesha uu ka shidmo gaariga, iyo meesha furaha laga geliyaba. e.g. Have you switched the ignition on?
ignominious: /ignaminiyas/ignominiously/ (adj) wax ceeb iyo sharaf dhac ah. e.g. He suffered an ignominious defeat in the election,
ignorant: /ignorant/ ignorance; (adj) 1. jaahil (aqoon la') aqoon darro. e.g. He is ignorant because he has never been to school. 2. ogaal la'aan (arrin aadan waxba ka ogeyn). e.g. Some people are ignorant of their rights.
ignore: /ignoor/ignores, ignoring, ignored; (v) iska dhaga tirid, iska maahin, iska-jaahil yeelid (ogaal-diid). e.g. He ignored my question.
ill: /il/ills, illness; (adj) 1. jirran, buka (xanuunsanaya). e.g. She was very ill in the hospital.(n) 2. wax xun oo dhibaato badana waa loo adeegsadaa. e.g. We have to live with the ills of life.
I'll: (abbr) I will ama I shall oo la soo gaabiyey. e.g. I'll go out this weekend.
illegal: /illiigal/illegality; (adj) sharci darro (ka soo horjeeda waxa la ogol yahay). e.g. Drugs are illegal in this country.
illegible: /illejabal/ (adj) far ama qoraal aan la akhrin karin. e.g. I found a book with an illegible name on it.
illegitimate: /ilijitamit/illegitimacy;(adj) 1. ilmo aan sharci ku dhalan (garac, wacal) e.g. an illegitimate boy 2. aan sharci ahayn (sharciga khilaafsan). e.g. It was an illegitimate meeting.
illicit: /illisit/illicitly; (adj) sharci darro (sharciga mamnuuc ku ah). e.g. He was arrested for selling illicit drug.
illiterate: /illitarit/ illiteracy;(adj) aan waxna akhrin waxna qorin (ummi). e.g. He is still illiterate.
illness: /ilnis/illnesses;(n) cudur (jirro). e.g. She had a serious illness.
ill-treat: /il-triit/ill-treats, ill-treating, ill-treated; (v) si xun u xannaanayn (daryeelid la'aan). e.g. He ill-treated his animals.
illuminate: /iluumaneyt/illuminates, illuminating, illuminated; (v) 1. iftiimin ama ilaysin. e.g. This candle illuminates the whole house. 2. wax micnahooda aad sii iftiimisid ama sii faahfaahisid.
illusory: /illuusari/ (adj) wax run ahaan u muuqda laakiin been ah ama aan jirinba khayaali.
illustrate: /ilastreyt/illustrates, illustrating, illustrated; (v) sharxid ama sifayn leh tusaalooyin iyo sawiro tusmayn. e.g. She illustrated her meaning with well-chosen examples.
illustrious: /illastriyas/illustriously;(adj) qof caan ah (wax gaar ah caan ku noqday)
image: /imij/images;(n) 1. masawir, gaar ahaan muuqaalka aad maskaxda ka sawirato. e.g. He had a very strange image about life in the country.(n) 2. muuqaalka ama sida laga aaminsanyahay qof ama wax. e.g.The prime minister has to improve his image. 3. sanam.
imaginable: /imaajinabal/ (adj) la sawiran karo, maskaxda kusoo dhici kara.
imaginary: /imaajaneri/ (adj) khayaali (sawir maskaxeed). e.g. an imaginary illness.
imagination: /imaajaneyshan/ (n) male ama khayaal abuurid (maskaxda). e.g. You didn't see anything; it was only your imagination.
imagine: /imaajin/imagines, imagining, imagined; (v) sawirasho, qiyaasid, malayn (xaga maskaxda). e.g. He imagines that people don't like him.
imbibe: /imbayb/ imbibes, imbibing, imbibed;(v) cabbid ama qaadasho gaar ahaan khamriga.
imbue: /imbyuu/imbues, imbuing, imbued; (v) ka dherjin ama ka buuxin, fikrad ama dareen gaar ah. e.g. Politicians are imbued with a sense of their own importance.
imitate: /imateyt/imitates, imitating, imitated; (v) iska yeel-yeelid (ka tusaale qaadasho). e.g. He tries to imitate his father's voice.
imitative: /imateytiv/ (adj) lugu dayan karo, laga tusaale qaadan karo.
immaculate: /imaakyalit/immaculately; (adj) nadiif ah, aadna u qurxoon. e.g. Her house is always immaculate.
immaterial: /imatiriyal/ (adj) wax aan qiima lahayn (qiima aan ku fadhiyin); aan muhim ahayn.
immature: /imajuur/immaturity; (adj) aan qaan gaar ahayn (aan baaluqin); waqtigiisii aan gaarin. e.g. He acts like an immature person.
immeasurable: /imesharabal/immeasurably;(adj) aan la cabbiri karin (aan la qiyaasi karin).
immediacy: /imiidhiyasi/ (n) isla-hadda, dhakhsa ah (arin waqtigeedii la joogo).
immediate: /imiidhiyit/ (adj) 1. isla markiiba (aan daahdaah lahayn); dhakhso. e.g. This matter needs immediate attention.(adj) 2. aad kuugu dhow. e.g. Is he part of your immediate family?
immediately: /imiidhiyitli/ (adv) haddeer (isla hadda); hadda (degdeg). e.g. I can start this job immediately.
immense: /imens/immensely;(adj) aad u weyn (baaxad weyn). e.g. an immense city.
immensity: /imensiti/ (n) baaxad weyni; tira badni (meesha ugu badan).
immerse: /imers/immerses, immersing, immersed; (v) 1. biyo dhex gelid, quusin (biyo dhex muquufid).(v) 2. wax aad dhex gashid. e.g. He is immersed in his book.
immersion heater: /imershan hiitar/ (n) qalab koronto oo dhaliya biyaha kulul ee guriga iwm loo isticmaalo.
immigrant: /imagranti/immigrants; (n) qofka ka soo haajiray waddankiisii qaxooti, dool. e.g. Somali immigrants are coming to Canada in increasing numbers.
imminent: /immanant/ (adj) wax dhakhso u dhici doona; foodda nugu soo haya (deg-deg loo filayo). e.g. I knew that his departure was imminent.
immobilize: /immobilays/immobolizes, immobilizing, immobilized; (v) dhaq-dhaqaaq loo diiday (socsocod la'aan).
immortal: /immoortal/immortality; (adj) waaraya (aan weligii dhimanayn). e.g. Nobody is immortal.
immune: /immiyuun/immunization; (adj) tallaal (cudur ama wax qof laga difaacay,oo aan asiibi karin).
immutable: /immiyuutabal/ (adj) aan la bedeli karin. e.g. immutable rules.
impact: /impaakt/ (n) 1. raad ku reebid; saamayn (sabab u noqosho).(n) 2. falka ama xooga ka dhasha markii shay uu shay kale ku dhaco.
impair: /impeer/impairs, impairing, impaired; (v) daciifin, doorin, dhaawicid. (sidii caadiga ahaa ka baddalid). e.g. Loud music had impaired his hearing. He was impaired by alcohol.
impart: /impart/imparts, imparting, imparted; (v) siin ama u gudbin. e.g. She had some news to impart.
impartial: /imparshal/impartiality; (adj) eex la'aan ah, si daacad ah u gar qaadaya, dhanna aan raacsanayn. e.g. an impartial judge.
impassable: /impaasabal/ (adj) aan la gudbi karin, aan la mari karin.
impasse: /impaas/ (n) 1. meel aan la dhaafi karin, soo xiran (lama-dhaafaan). (n) 2. arrin dhib badan oo aan meelna loo saari karin.
impassioned: /impaashandh/ (adj) dareen qoto dheer (qiiro iyo dareen leh). e.g. We had a long impassioned debate.
impassive: /impaasiv/impassively; (adj) aad dareen lahayn (aan qiiro iyo dareen ka muuqan).
impeach: /impiij/ (v) dambi culus ku soo oogid siiba danbi qaranka laga galo.
impeccable: /impekabal/impeccably; (adj) khalad aan lahayn ama ceeb aan lahayn.
impediment: /impedhamant/ (n) carqalad ama shoobaro hawl curyaamisa. e.g. I can't understand him because he has a speech impediment.
impel: /impel/ (v) ku xambaarid; ku dadajin (wax kugu khasba inaad arin ku dhaqaaqdid.
impending: /impendin/ (adj) wax degdeg u dhici doona ama (dhakhsa u imaan doona).
imperative: /imperativ/ (adj) 1. arin muhiim ah in dhakhso loo qabto (mudnaanta koowaad la siiyo) (adj) 2. lagama maarmaan; aasaasi ah (daruuri) (n) 3. naxwe ahaan (falka amarka bixiya)
imperceptible: /imparseptabal/imperceptibly, imperceptibility; (adj) aad u yar; aan la arki karin (ilma qabato).
imperfect: /imperfikt/imperfectly; (adj) 1. wax aan dhammays-tirnayn (wax aan sax ahayn) (n) 2. naxwe ahaan (fal aan dhammaystirnayn).
imperil: /imperal/imperils, imperiling, imperilled; (v) khatar gelin (la khatar gesho).
impersonate: /impersaneyt/ impersonation;(v) iska yeel-yeelid (qof kale iska dhigdhigid, isku ekaysiin).
impervious: /imperviyas/ (adj) aan waxba ka gudbi karin (aan waxba karin). e.g. This material is impervious to water.
impetuous: /impetshuwas/ (adj) qofka deg-degga badan ama seef la boodka ah. e.g. an impetuous man.
implacable: /implaakabal/ (adj) aan la dajin karin, (qandhar ah; aan la qancin karin markuu xanaaqo ama wax diido). e.g. He is an implacable opponent.
implant: /impla ant/implants, implanting, implanted; (v) 1. abuurid; (xubin qofka jirkiisa lugu abuuro). 2. fikrad ku abuurid qof maskaxdiis.
implement: /implamenti/ (v) 1. qalab ama aalad lugu shaqeeyo. (v) 2. fulin, (arin wax ka qabashadeed); ka baaraan-dagiddeed.
implicate: /implikeyt/implicates, implicating, implicated; (v) 1. caddayn in qof dambi ku lug lahaa, (tusid in qof kale dambiga wax kaga jiray).(v) 2. maldahid, (sarbeebid).
implication: /implikeyshan/implications;(n) 1. hadal aan dhab loo muujin, laakiin laga fahmi karo hadal la yiri ama wajiga qofka. (n) 2. dambi ku lug yeelasho: (n) 3. maldahnaan.
implicit: /implisit/implicitly; (adj) 1. maldahan, (hadal dahsoon). e.g. She insulted me implicitly.(adj) 2. si kalsooni leh u rumayn, (aad iyo aad u aaminid). e.g. implicit faith.
implore: /imploor/implores, imploring, implored; (v) codsasho (baryid); tuugid. e.g. I implore you to do it for me.
imply: /implay/ (v) si dahsoon hadal u sheegid, (dareensiin si ficil ah ama hadal maldahan ah).
imponderable: /impodharabal/ (adj) muhiimadeeda aan la qiyaasi karin (la soo koobi karin).
import: /impoort/ (v) 1. soo dejin (alaab dibadda ka soo dejin). (n) 2. shay dibadda laga keenay (eestaro).
importer: /impoortar/ (n) soo dejiye (qof ama shirkad dibadda wax ka keenta).
impose: /impows/ (v) 1. dulsaar (canshuurta ama wixii la mid ah oo qof lugu waajib yeelo). e.g. The government imposed new taxes.(v) 2. ku khasbid ama ku amarsiin qof wax dhib ku ah. e.g. He imposed severe discipline on his children.
imposing: /impowsin/ (adj) muuqaal xajmi iyo xoog leh (aad u weyn). e.g. There is an imposing building across the street.
impossible: /imposabal/ (adj) aan suurtagal ahayn (aan dhici karin). e.g. It is impossible to finish this job by tonight.
impostor: /impostar/impostors; (n) qof iska yeela ama iska dhiga qof kale si uu wax u khiyaamo.
impotent: /impotant/ (adj) 1. awood darro (hawl qaban waayid) (adj) 2. tabar darro xaga isutegidda ragga iyo dumarka.
impound: /impawndh/impounds, impounding, impounded; (v) la wareegid (xoolahaaga oo si sharci ah loola wareego). e.g. If you leave your car here, the police will impound it.
impoverish: /impovarish/impoverishes, impoverishing, impoverished;(v) faqri ka dhigid (qof ama dal faqri noqda); fakhrisiin.
impractical: /impraaktikal/ (adj) aan la tijaabin karin (wax aan dhab ahaan loo fulin karin).
impregnate: /impregneyt/impregnates, impregnating, impregnated/ (v) 1. shay lugu milo ama la dhex-geliyo shay kale (isku cadaadin)(v) 2. uurayn (rimin)
impress: /impres/impresses, impressing, impressed; (v) 1. wax ama qof aad ka heshid ama la dhacdid. e.g. I was impressed by his manners.(v) 2. arin muhiimadeeda la muujiyo (la caddeeyo).
impression: /impreshan/impressions; (n) 1. sida wax kuugu muuqdaan (qof, shay, iwm), (aragtida ama fikradda aad wax ka qaadatid). e.g. What was your first impression of New York? (n) 2. raad ku reebid (astaan ku reebid). 3. qof kale iska yeel-yeelid.
improbably: /improbabal/ (adv) wax aan la filayn inuu dhaco ama rumoobo (aan suurto gal ahayn inuu dhaco).
impromptu: /impromptu/ (adj) arin ama ficil loo sameeyo deg-deg iyadoon laga fiirsan oon lugu talagalin.
improper: /impropar/ (adj) wax aan habboonayn (aan munaasib ahayn), qalloocan.
improve: /impruuv/ (v) hagaajin (horumarin) (sidii hore ka fiicnayn). e.g. I like to improve my English.
improvise: /improvays/improvises, improvised, improvising; (v) hawl ama ficil aad samaysid adigoon horey usoo-qorshayn ama uga soo fakarin. (fiiro la'aan hawl u qabasho).
impudent: /impyudhant/impudence/ (adj) xishood daran, edeb daran xushmad daran (dabeecad xun). e.g. The impudent child shouted at her mother.
impulse: /impals/ (n) rabitaan deg-deg ah (jamasho). e.g. She bought the car on impulse.
impulsive: /impalsiv/ impulsively/ (adj) sal-fudud (qofka asagoon ka fiirsan wax sameeya).
impure: /impyuur/ (adj) aan saafi ahayn (wax kale ku qasan yihiin).
in: /in/ (prep) 1. naxwe ahaan, meeleeye. 2. gudaha (meel gudeheed tilmaamid). e.g. in the house 3. wakhti dhexdiis. e.g. in July 4. xaalad ama duruuf tilmaamid. e.g. She is in poor health. 5. xiriir ama cilaaqo tilmaamid. e.g. They trust in Allah. 6. saami (ama nisbo tusinaya).e.g. Two in every five are ten. 6. xirfad ama shaqa gaar ah tilmaamaya. e.g. She is in accounting.
inability: /inabiliti/ (n) aan awoodin (aan karin). e.g. She does not learn much because of her inability to listen.
inaccessible: /inaksesabal/ (adj) wax aan la gaari karin ama ay dhib badan tahay si loo gaaro.
inaccurate: /inaakyurit/ (adj) aan sax ahayn (khalad ku jiro); khaldan. e.g I came late because my watch was inaccurate.
inactive: /inaaktiv/ (adj) aan dhaqdhaqaaq lahayn (wax iska taagan ama iska fadhiya).
inadequate: /inaadhakwit/inadequately; (adj) aan ku filnayn (aan kaafin karin). e.g. inadequate funds.
inadvertent: /inadhvertant/inadvertently;(adj) kamma' (wax aan kas loo samayn), ulakac aan ahayn (shil ku dhacay).
inane: /ineyn/ (adj) wax aan micno ku fadhiyin (macno darro ah).
inanimate: /inaanamit/ (adj) aan noolayn (naf-aysan ku jirin), mannoole. e.g. Stone is inanimate.
inapplicable: /inaaplikabal/ (adj) aan ku habboonayn (aan ku lug lahayn), aan la xiriirin.
inattentive: /inatentiv/ (adj) aan foojigneyn (aad digtoonayn), maahsan. e.g. He is an inattentive student.
inaugural: /inoogyural/ (adj) 1. xaflad furitaan ama khudbo furitaan ah (furitaanka meel ugu horreeya). 2. caleema-saar.
inaugurate: /inoogyurayt/inaugurates, inaugurating, inaugurated; (v) 1. furitaan ama bilaabid meel cusub. e.g. The new factory was inaugurated last night.(v) 2. caleema saarid (boqrid).
inborn: /inboorn/ (adj) waxyaabaha dabiiciga ah ee qofku ku dhasho.
incalculable: /inkaalkyulabal/ (adj) aan caddad lahayn (aan la xisaabi karin).
incapable: /inkeeypabal/ (adj) aan la yeeli karin (aan la awoodi karin).
incapacitate: /inkapaasiteyt/ (v) tabar-darraysiin (jirro ama wixii qof ka dhiga mid aan awood lahayn).
incarnation: /inkarneyshan/ (n) 1. qofka oo mar labaad soo noolaada asagoo jismi (jir) kale leh (gaalada qaarkeed baa aaminsan).(n) 2. qof ama wax tusaale fiican u noqon kara wax kale.
incentive: /insentiv/ (n) wixii kugu dhiirri-geliya inaad wax qabato. e.g. Money is being used as an incentive.
incest: /insest/ (n) dembiga qof ka sineystay ama u tagay qof uusan geyin (guursan karin sharci ahaan).
inch: /inji/ (n) halbeeg lugu cabbiro dhererka, oo le'eg 2.54 sentimitir.
incident: /insedent/ (n) dhacdo (wax dhaca oo badanaa la xiriira rabsho ama dhib kale).
incidentally: /insedentali/ (adv) kalmad la isticmaalo markii wax siyaada ah (cusub) aad sheegaysid ama aad mawduuca beddeleysid. e.g. Incidentally, did you know that my sister is coming from Ottawa tonight?
incipient: /insipiyanti/ (adj) biloow ah (wax bilaabanaya ama biloow ah).
inclination: /inklaneyshan/ (n) rabitaan (danayn) (wixii aad rabtid ama aad niyad u haysid). e.g. I have no inclination to be a doctor.(n) 2. hoo's usoo janjeedhsasho (hoos usoo liicid).

intercept: /intarsept/ (v)joojin (wax ama qof dhexda lugu qabto intuusan meeshiisii gaarin). e.g. The drugs were intercepted at the border.

intercontinental: /intarkontanental/ (adj) qaaradaha oo dhan ka jira (laga isticmaalo). e.g. intercontinental flight.
interest: /intarast/ (v) 1. ahmiyad-siin; xiisayn. e.g. Can I interest you in some dessert? (n) 2. maslaxo, dan (faa'iido). e.g. I have an interest in the army. (n) 3. dulsaar (ribo).
interfere: /interfir/ (v) faragelin (hawl aad faraha la gashid ayadoon luguu amrin). e.g. Stop interfering in my work!
interference: /intarfirans/ (n) dhabqin am faraha la gelid (hawl socota).
interim: /intarim/ (adj) ku meel gaar ah (aan joogto ahayn). e.g. interim president.
interior: /intiriyar/ (n) gudaha (daakhilka). e.g. We decorated the interior of our house.
interloper: /intarlopar/ (n) qofka iska soo gala meel aan looga baahnayn.
interlude: /intarluudh/ (n) waqtiga bareegga la qaato (biririf). e.g. After this interlude, the dancing will continue.
intermarriage: /intarmaarij/ (n) kala guursasho (laba shicib ama laba qolo oo kala-guursada); isdhexgal xagga guurka.
intermingle: /intarmingal/ (v) is-dhexgelid (isku-dhex qasmid). e.g. The police intermingled with the protestors.
internal: /internal/ (adj) 1. gudaha ah (dhexdiisa). e.g. Is there any internal damage? 2. waddan gudihiis. e.g. Internal affairs of a country.
internment: /internmant/ (n) xirid, xabsi gelin (badanaa siyaasad u xirid).
interpret: /interprit/ (v) 1. u turjumid; ka turjumid (laba luuqadood kala turjumid). e.g. Sabaax had to interpret for me. 2. u fasirasho (ka fasirasho). e.g. He interpreted my silence as a refusal.
interpreter: /interpritar/ (n) turjume (turjumaan). e.g. She spoke to me through an interpreter.
interrogate: /interrageyt/ (v) imtixaanid (su'aalo badan weyddiin). e.g. She has been interrogated by the police.
interrogative: /interrogativ/ (adj) leh qaab su'aaleed (hab su'aaleed la xiriira). e.g. an interrogative sentence.
interrupt: /intarrapt/ (v) 1. ka dhex gelid, kalagoyn (ka khash-khashid qof hadlaya). e.g. She interrupted the speaker. 2. hawl socotay kala joojin (fadqalalayn).
interruption: /intarrapshan/ (n) kala go', hakad gelid (hawl socotay oo in yar joogsata).
interval: /intarval/ (n) waqti u dhexeeya laba dhacdo (bareeg; biririf).
intervene: /intarviin/ (v) 1. soo dhex-gelid si loo dhex-dhexaadiyo (dad is haysta). e.g. They were fighting until their father intervened. 2. dhabqin (hakin) (hadal ama hawl socotay). e.g. I'll come tomorrow if something doesn't intervene.
interview: /intarviyuu/ (n) kulan waraysi ah (is-arag qof lugu waraysto). e.g. I had two job interviews yesterday.
intimate: /intameyt/ (adj) 1. saaxiibtinimo nafta laysu huro (nin iyo naag aan waxba isu diidin oo kale). e.g. She had been intimate with a lot of men. 2. qofka arimihiisa khaaska ah (shakhsiga ah). e.g. I told him the most intimate details of my personal life. 3. faahfaahin lugu ogaaday cilmi baaris. e.g. Ask someone with an intimate knowledge of the city.
introduce: /intradhiyuus/ (v) 1. is-barid (laba qof). e.g. He introduced Ali to Fatima. 2. soo ban-dhigid. e.g. He introduced a new bill.
introduction: /intradhakshan/ (n) 1. bandhig (soo ban dhigid) 2. horudhac ~ arar, gogoldhig. 3. isbaritaan (laba qof).
introductory: /intradhaktari/ (adj) hordhac (qaybta u horraysa mawduuc ama maaddo). e.g introductory courses.
introvert: /intravert/introverts, introverted; (n) qofka afka-gaaban, xishoodka badan ee kali socodka ah.
intrude: /intruudh/ (v) qasid ama dhabqin (meel aan lagaaga baahnayn).
intruder: /intruudhar/ (n) qofka dhabqiya ama iska soo gala meel aan looga yeerin (loo ogolayn).
inundate: /inandheyt/ (v) fatahma (wax tiro badan oo hal mar meel kusoo wada dhaca), faruurma. e.g. I have been inundated with applications.
invade: /inveydh/ (v) 1. gelid dal si loo qabsado (xoog ku qabsasho milateri). e.g. Kuwait was invaded by Iraq. 2. tiro badan meel ku gelid.e.g. Reporters invaded the city.
invalid: /invaalidh/ (adj) aan la isticmaali karin, aan soconayn, aan shaqaynayn (aan qiimo lahayn). e.g.invalid passports.
invalidate: /invaaladheyt/ wax aan la isticmaali karin ka dhigid (wax aan soconayn ka dhigid), burin.
invariable: /inveriyabal/ (adj) ma-doorsoome (aan is beddelin, markasta hal si ah).
invasion: /inveyshan/ (n) xoog milatari waddan ku qabsasho. e.g. Iraq's invasion of Kuwait.
invent: /invent/invention; (v) 1. soo saarid wax cusub (ikhtiraacid). e.g. the man who invented computers. 2. allifid (sheeko iwm).
inventory: /inventari/ (n) liiska ama tirada alaab meel taal (ama bakhaar ku jirta).
inverse: /invers/ (adj) 1. dhanka kale u rogan (la kala qalibo). 2. saami, lid ah (caksi ah) (laba tiro oo mid markuu bato kan kale yaraado).
inverted comma: / (n) faasilooyin ama hakadyo qoraalada geesaha looga xiro sida /” “/.
invest: /invest/ (v) maalgelin (la maal-geliyo). e.g. She had invested a lot of time and money in this project.
investigate: /investageyt/ (v) baarid (baaritaan samayn si runta loo gaaro). e.g. This case was investigated by the police.
invincible: /invinsabal/ (adj) aan la jabin karin (ciidan ama koox aan laga adkaan karin).
invisible: /invisabal/ (adj) aan la arki karin (aan ishu qaban karin).
invite: /invayt/ (v) casuumid (marti-qaad u fidin). e.g. He invited me to the party.
inviting: /invaytin/ (adj) kusoo jiidanaya (soo jiidasho leh), ku niyad gelinaya.
invoice: /invoys/ (n) qaansheeg lugu xuso tirada iyo qiimaha alaabta ~ biil. e.g. Our company sent him an invoice a month ago.
invoke: /invowk/ (v) 1. awood sare tuugid (ilaah baryid). 2. baryid (caawimaad weydiisasho). e.g. He invoked her help.
involuntary: /involanteri/involuntarily; (adj) wax aadan kas u samayn. (aadan ikhyaar kaaga u samayn, laakiin adoon is ogeyn kaa dhacay). e.g. She smiled involuntarily.
involve: /involv/involved;(v) 1. dhex-gelin ku-darid (ku-xirid). e.g. Don't involve other boys in your mistakes. 2. ka mid ah ama ku lug-leh (ku jira). e.g. My job involves a lot of travelling. 3. ka qayb-qaato (ku dhex-jira). e.g. He is involved in community affairs. 4. dhib badan (jumlo ama wax aan la fahmi karin). e.g. What an involved sentence.
iodine: /ayadin/ (n) saliid-naar (daawo loo isticmaalo nabarada iyo masawirda caddayntooda).
iota: /ayota/ (n) aad iyo aad wax u yar. e.g. I don't think there is an iota of truth in that.
IOU: /ay-ow-yuu/ (n) 'I owe you' oo la soo gaabiyey 'waxaad igu leedahay'. (qofka deynta lugu leeyahay ayaa qora). e.g. I can't pay you now. Can I write you an IOU for $50?
IQ: /ay-kiyuu/ (n) intelligence quotient' oo lasoo gaabiyey (imtixaan lugu ogaado qofka caqligiisa). e.g. She had an IQ of 50.
irk: /erk/ (v) dhibid (ka xanaajin) e.g. Such behaviour clearly irked Bashiir.
irksome: /erksam/ (adj) wax dhibaato iyo xanaaq abuuraya. e.g. It seems to me that his methods are irksome.
iron: /ayran/ (n) 1. xadiid (birta xadiidka ah). e.g. It is made from iron. 2. macdan cuntada qaarkeed ku jirta. 3. kaawiyad (feero). e.g. She can't iron my shirt. 4. qof ad-adag (xadiid lugu matalay).
irony: /ayrani/ (n) kajan (hadal kajan iyo ciyaar ah), jeesjees. e.g. He said with irony, 'You are very beautiful.'
irrational: /irraashanal/ (adj) tasarufaad ama fal aan macquul ahayn (aan maskax ku dhisnayn).
irreconcilable: /irrekansaylabal/ (adj) aad u kala fog, wax aan marna lugu heshiin karin (aan laysku keeni karin).
irreducible: /irridhiyuusabal/ (adj) aan la dhimi karin (aan la yarayn karin).
irregular: /irregular/ (adj) 1. aan caadi ahayn. 2. lid ku ah sharciga. 3. naxwe ahaan (ficilka qoraarlkiisu isbeddalo).
irrelevant: /irrelavant/ (adj) hadal aan mawduuca laga hadlayo khusayn (khaarij mawduuc).
irreligious: /irrilijas/ (adj) aan diin haysan (aan qof diimeed ahayn).
irreparable: /irreperabal/ (adj) aan la hagaajin karin (aan dib loo samayn karin).
irreplaceable: /irripleysabal/ (adj) wax aan baddalkiisa la heli karin (wax u dhigma aysan jirin).
irrespective of: /irrispektiv of/ (prep) aan tixgelin la siin (aan ahmiyad la siin).
irrevocable: /irrevakabal/ (adj) aan la beddeli karin. e.g. an irrevocable decision.
irritable: /irratabal/ (adj) qofka wax kasta ka xanaaqa (car i taabo, xanaaqa fudud).
irritant: /irratant/ (adj) 1. waxa qof ka caraysiiya (xanaajiya). 2. wax jirka cun-cun u keena.
irritate: /irrateyt/ (v) 1. ka xanaajin (ka caraysiin). 2. cun-cun abuurid (wax cun-cun kuu keena).
isolate: /aysaleyt/ (v) gooni u takooran (meel cidla' ah kali ku ah).
isolated: /aysaleytidh/ (adj) 1. geeri go'an ah 2. cidla' ah (kali ah).
issue: /ishyuu/ (n) 1. soo bixid joornaal, iwm. (daabacaad la soo saaro), soo saarid. e.g. I bought the newspaper the day after its issue.(n) 2. mawduuc ama qodob muhiim ah. e.g. Don't make it a big issue.(v) 3. la siiyo (qof si sharci ah wax loogu sameeyo). e.g. I'll issue a passport for you.
isthmus: /ismas/ (n) meel yar oo isku xirta laba dhul oo weyn.
it: /it/ (pron) magac u yaalka mannoolaha iyo xayawaanka.
italics: /itaaliks/ (n) xarfo ku qoran far yar-yar oo jiifta.
itch: /ij/ (n) 1. cun-cun jirka ah (xoq-xoq rabid). e.g. An itch must be scratched. 2. wax aad deg-deg u rabtid inaad samayso (aadan dhowri karin). e.g. The students were itching for the lesson to end.
itinerant: /aytinarant/ (adj) hadba meel u safra (had iyo jeer safra)
itinerary: /aytinareri/ (n) faahfaahin safar ku saabsan (meelaha la booqan doono, dariiqa la mari doono, waqtiga iwm).
ivy: /ayvi/ (n) geed ka dhex baxa darbiyada iyo geedaha kale oo caleemo dhalaalaya leh (saar)
jab: /jaab/ (v) 1. ku mudid (juq ku siin) (n) 2. irbad ku durid (durmo) e.g. She jabbed the knife into the fruit.
jabber: /jaabar/ (v) hadal daldalid (si dhakhso ah oo aan la fahmi karin u hadlid). e.g. They were jabbering at each other in French.
jack: /jaak/ (n) 1. giriig (qalab alaabta culculus lugu qaado siiba baabuurta) 2. warqadaha turubka midda ninku ku sawiran yahay (qulaan) 3. shakhsi (qof).
jacket: /jaakit/ (n) 1. jaakeet (koor shaatiga laga dul gashado). e.g. I have two sports jackets. 2. diirka baradhada (qubka bataatada).
jack-knife: /jaak-nayf/ (n) 1. mindida galka leh (00 laysku laabo).(v) 2. kala jiirayn (baabuur dhakso u kala wareega waddada dhexdeeda).
jack pot: /jaackpot/ (n) lacagta ugu badan ee gof ku guuleysto (khamaar ama bakhtiyaa-nasiib).
jack up: /jaak ap/ (v) giriig ku dallicid (giriig ku qaadid). e.g. Could you jack up the car please?
jade: /jeydh/ (adj) dhagax cagaaran oo qaali ah (laga sameeyo almaasta iwm).
jagged: /jaagidh/ (adj) shay girgirro leh (aan lahayn qar siman ama sulub ah).
jaguar: /jaagwar/ (n) bahal haramcadka u eg oo laga helo Ameerika oo dheereeya.
jail: /jeyl.(n) xabsi. e.g. He spent three years in jail.
jam: /jaam/ (n) 1. malmalaado (rootiga la marsado) 2. ku ciriirin (meel aad u buuxda xoog ku gelin) e.g. Nothing else can be jammed into this bag. 3. si xoog ah oo dhakhsa ah u riixid. (dhakhsa u cadaadin). e.g. I had to stop quickly, so I jammed on the brakes. 4. meel saxmad ah oo aad loo buuxo. e.g. Traffic jam.
jamboree: /jaambarii/ (n) xaflad weyn oo dad badan isugu yimaadeen.
jam packed: / (adj) buux dhaaftay (meel buuxsantay oo aan boos ka bannaanayn).
jangle: /jaangal/ (v) dhawaq qalalaw leh (dhawaaq sida laba bir oo isku dhacaya samayn).
jar: /jar/ (n) 1. dhalo (qullada malmalaadada laga isticmaalo oo kale) e.g jar of jam. 2. wax jiriirica leh (kaa nixiya).
jargon: /jargan/ (n) hadal xirfad ama cilmi gaar ah loo isticmaalo (erey-bixin cilmiyeed). e.g. They use a lot of professional jargon.
javelin: /jaavalin/ (n) murjis (waran af dhuuban oo isboortiga lugu ciyaaro).
jay walk: /jeywook/ (v) si aan taxadar lahayn waddo u goyn.
jazz: /jaas/ (n) muusigga jaaska (muusig hal mar laysla garaaco qof kasta iskiis); qoobka ciyaar.
jazzy: /jaasi/ (adj) 1. jaas oo kale ah 2. soo jiidasho leh oo midabo badan lugu qurxiyey.
jeer: /jiir/ (v) 1. qosol jees-jees ah 2. qosol dheer-dheer (si xoog ah u qoslid).
jelly: /jeli/ (n) 1. macmacaan aad u jiljilicsan 2. shay kasta oo u dhexeeya dareere iyo adke.
jerk: /jerk/ (v) 1. xoog usoo siibid (dhakhso usoo bixin) 2. dhakhso u bixid (u dhaqaaqid).
jet: /jet/ (n) 1. burqad (biyo ama dareere dhuun yar xoog uga soo butaacaya) e.g He directed a jet stream of water into the air.2. diyaarad yar.
jewellery: /juulari/ (n) majoowharaad (alaab qaali ah oo dumarku isku qurxiyo sida, silsiladda, dhegaha, burshaleetada iwm).
jilt: /jilt/ (v) iska-dirid, (iska-cayrin, siiba laba qof oo jacayl ka dhaxeeyey) eg. After being her boyfriend for five years, he suddenly jilted her.
job lot: /jab lot/ (n) alaab kala nooc ah oo laysku gado.
jockey: /joki/ (n) 1. qofka fardaha ku tartama 2. gofka jago ama shaqo u qabta si xirfad badni ah.
jog: /jog/ (v) 1. hantaatiqin (riixid ama jagayn) 2. aayar u dhaqaaqid.
join: /jooyn/ (v) 1. isku xirid (ku dhejin) 2. ku darsamid (ka mid noqosho).
joint: /jooynt/ (n) 1. guntin (meesha wax isaga xirmaan ama iska-galaan). 2. kalagoys (meesha xubnaha jirku iska galaan) 3. wax dad ka dhexeeya (wadajir).
joker: /jookar/ (n) 1. qofka maadeeya ama kaftama 2. warqada turubka ee meel kasta geli karta (ciyaarta).
jot: /jot/jot down;(n) 1. wax aad u yar (in yar).(v) 2. dhakhso wax u qorid (qoraal boobta ah).
journal: /joornal/ (n) wargeys (joornaal urur ama dad gaar ah soo saaraan).
journalist: /joornalist/ (n) qofka weriyaha ah ama wargeysyada qora (suxufi).
jubilant: /jubalant/ (adj) farxad ka muugato (aad u faraxsan); rayrayn leh) e.g. A jubilant man.
judgment: /jajmant/ (n) 1. go'aan maxkamadeed (xukun soo saarid) 2. guddoomin (ka talin) (ka gar-niqid).
judgement day: /jajmant dhey/ day of judgement; (n) maalinta lays xukumayo (maalinta aakhiro).
judiciary: /judhishiyeri/ (n) nidaamka sharciga iyo garsooridda ee waddan.
jug: /jag/ (n) garaafo (weel dheg leh oo wax lugu shubto).
jumbo: /jambo/ (adj) ka weyn waxyaabaha kale oo la nooca ah.
junior: /junyar/ (n) 1. yaraan (da' yari)(adj) 2. darajo hoose (heer biloow ah).
juror: /jurar/ (n) qof loo doortay inuu ka mid noqdo garsoorayaal dadweyne (xeer-beege).
jury: /juuri/ (n) dad loo dhaarshay inay noqdaan garsoore dadweyne (xeerbeeg).
just: /jast/ (adj) 1. caaddil, caddaalad (adv) 2. sidaas laftigeeda eg. That is just my idea. 3. isla markaas (isla-haddeer) e.g. I'm going just now? 4. in yar (kaliya). e.g. Just a minute. 5. aan ka badnayn.e.g. Just what do you want to tell me?
justify: /jastafay/ (v) sabab sheegid; caddayn sabab fiican u yeelid.
jute: /juut/ (n) mayrax laga sameeyo xargo iyo shiraacyo waaweyn.
K,k: /key/ xarafka kow iyo tobnaad ee alifbeetada ingiriisiga.
kale: /keyl/ (n) nooc kaabajk'a ka mid ah (khudrad caleemeheeda la karsado).
kaleidoscope: /kalaydhaskowb/ (n) 1. tuubbo markii la wareejiyo midabbo indha sarcaad ah leh. 2. wax kasta oo markii la wareejiyo midabbo sameeya.
kangaroo: / kaangaruu/ (n) kira ngewe (xayawaan ustareeliya ku nool oo ku booda lugaha dambe, dhaddiguna carruurta caloosha ku qaato).
karate: /karatii/ (n) karateega (dagaalka gacmaha, suxulada iyo lugaha lugu dagaalo)
kebab: /kabab/ (n) hilib qori lugu mudo oo lugu dubo, iyo qudaar (cunto Carbeed).
keel: /kiil/on an even keel;(n) 1. birta dhexe oo doontu ku dhisan tahay (udub dhexaadka doonta). 2. wax dagan oo sidii la rabay u socda (si miisaaman u socda).
keel over: /kiil ovar/ (v) gees ka dhicid (dhan ka dhicid).
keen: /kiin/ (adj) 1. aad u danaynaya; usoo jeeda (niyad fiican u haya). e.g. Most girls are not keen on football. 2. af wax gooya leh; fiiqan (mindida, sakiinta iwm).
keep: /kiip/ keeping, kept;(v) 1. hayn; gacan ku hayn (sii hayn) e.g. Can you keep these books for me? (v) 2. xafidid; xajin (sidii ballanku ahaa u fulin).e.g. He kept his promise.
keep back: /kiip baak/ (v) wax la harid (dib wax u haysasho). e.g. He decided to keep back all the information.
keep down: /kiip dhawn/ (v) hoos u hayn (horukac u diidid); koontaroolid. e.g. It is very important to keep costs down.
keep on: /kiip on/ (v) ku soco (hakala joojin); ku wad. e.g. Keep on doing this.
keep up: /kiip ap/ (v) 1. kor u hayn (meeshiisa ku hayn). 2. hawl sare hayn (heer sare wax u samayn) e.g. Keep up the good work! 3. la qabsad (sida wax yihiin ula socosho). e.g. He can't keep up with you when you are running.
keeper: /kiipar/ (n) ilaaliye (qofka xil gaar ah haya). e.g. The keeper is feeding the animals in the zoo.
kennel: /Kenal/ (n) xero eeyga lugu xereeyo (00 cariish u eg)
kernel: /kernal/ (n) 1. iniinta miraha ku dhex jirta (iniinta hoose) 2. nuxurka ama dhumucda (arini leedahay)
ketchup: /kejab/ (n) yaanyo shiidan oo la meceeyey (00 cuntada lugu cuno). e.g. Could you give me some ketchup for my hot dog?
key: /kii/ (n) 1. fure; muftaax e.g. Have you seen my keys? 2. xal u ah (fure u ah) e.g. A key to this problem. 3. badhanka la garaaco (botoonka teebka iwm). e.g. You have to press the return key. 4. muhiim ah (ugu muhiim san). e.g. Education is the key to success.
kg: / (abbr) kilo-gram oo la soo gaabiyey (hal kiilo)
kick: /kik/kicking, kicked, kicks;(v) 1. laad (lugta ku hardiyid); laadid. 2. farxad iyo raaxo ka helid. e.g. He drives fast just for kicks.
kick off: /kik of/ (v) darbada ciyaartu ku bilaabanto (laadka ugu horreeya)
kick out: /kik awt/ (v) cayrin (laad ku saarid); dibadda u laadid.
kid: /kidh/ (infl)(n) 1. cunug, ilmo yar e.g. How many kids do you have? 2. dhalinyaro. 2. ceesaan, neef ari ah oo dhalin yar.
kidnap: /kidhnaab/ (v) af-duubid (qafaalid) e.g. She was kidnapped last night.
kill: /kil/ (v) 1. dil (gudha ka jarid) 2. waqti dilid (waqti dhumin) e.g. kill time. 3. laba shimbirood hal dhagax ku dilid (laba natiijo hal ficil ka helid). e.g. Kill two birds with one stone.
kilowatt: /kilo waat/ (n) hal kiilowaat (= 1000 waat), korontada ayaa lugu cabbiraa).
kin: /kin/ (n) qaraabo; ehel (xigaalo) e.g. Who is your next of kin?
kind: /kayndhi/ (n) 1. nooc; jaad e.g. Do you have any other kind? 2. naxariis badan. e.g. My mother was very kind to me.
kindergarten: /kindhar gardhan/ (n) dugsiga barbaarinta carruurta yar-yar. (4 jir-ilaa 6 jir)
kindle: /kindhal/ (v) 1. shidid; dab ku dhajin (daarid) e.g. The wood is wet and would not kindle easily. 2. sii kicin; sii hurin (sii xoojin arin ama ra'yi iwm). e.g. His interest was kindled.
kindly: /kayndhali/ (adj) 1. si naxariis leh (raxmad leh). e.g. You have to treat your neighbours kindly. 2. min-fadlag (bilisxaanag). e.g. Will you kindly close the window?
kindred: /kidh rid/ (n) 1. qaraabo; ehel e.g. None of my kindred were present at my party. 2. isku mid ah, isku dabeecad ah (laba qof oo isku dad ah). e.g. She and I are kindred spirits.

zodiac: /zowdhiyaak/ (n) burji (xiddiga ama nasiibka qofka, oo qof walba laga qiyaaso dhalashadiisa).
zoo: /zuu/ (n) beerta xayawaanka la daawado lugu xannaaneeyo. e.g. Let's take the children to the zoo.
Zulu: /zuuluu/ (n) qabiil Afrikaan ah oo Koonfur Afrika daga ~ Suuluu.

a: a': (alif) the first letter of Somali al-phabet, according to the style adopted by this dictionary, it is a vowel letter ~ shaqal.
a': (suffix) [the] definite article of some masculine nouns. Ex. arag; aragga; the sight, in English, the indefinite articles are a and an and the definite article is the.

a': (suffix) —s; used to form the third person masculine plural present tense of verbs. Ex: friya; that looks..; maqla; that hears; hurda; that sleeps; Ex: xayawaanka cawska cuna...; animals that eats grass...
aa: aa': (n) long vowel of letter A. Ex: aabbe; father. Caano; milk.
aa?: (suffix); —ing; used to form the present continuous tense. Ex: ma socotaa; are you going; Wuu hurdaa; he is sleeping.
aabayeel: -ay / aabayeeshay: (v) respect (ris-pekt); consideration or courtesy. Ex: Waxba uma aabayeelin; he didn't respect anything ~ turid, —u aabayeel: (v) be considerate (bi kon-sidereyt); be thoughtful ~ tixgali —u aabayeelid -da: (n) consideration (kon-sidereyshin)
aabbanimo: -aabbanimada: (n) fatherhood (fader-huudh); the state of being a father.
aabbur: -ka: (n) lid (lid); cover (kaver); top ~ dabool, guf. Ex. aabburka ka qaad; take the lid off.
aabburan: -aabburnaa / aabburnayd: (adj) covered (koveridh); plugged (palaagid) ~ daboolan, gufeysan aabi -ga: (n) aggression (agreshen); the act of initiating a quarrel, a fight or an attack ~ gardarro, daandaasi aabuteey -ga: (n) kite (kayt) ~ warqadda cirka loo diro oo xariga leh
aabyood: ay /aabyootay: (v) provoke (pro-vowk). Ex: ku aabyood; incite to anger or resentment
aad: aad': (pronoun) you (vuu) ~ adi-ga. Ex: waraagdii aad keentay.... the letter you brought.
aad? -ay / day: (n) 1. go (goo). Ex: isbitaalka aad: go to the hospital. 2. aad: (adv) very (veeri); in a high degree; extremely, very much. Ex: aad u jarasan; very happy.
—aad': (suffix) -th; used to form ordinal numbers. Ex: afaraad; fourth (foorth); 4ih
aad iyo aad: (adv) extremely. (ikistrimli); very intense. Ex: aad iyo aad baan ugu baahnahay; I need it very much -isku aad -ka: (n) [sports] playoff also play-off. Ex: isku aadka kooxaha; the playoff of the teams —isku aaddi -yey / say: (V) align (alayn); to arrange in a line or line up. Ex: safka isku aaddi: line up
aadaab: aadaab-ta: (n) politeness (polaayt-nes); manners (man neris); etiquette (eti keeyt) ~ akhlaaq
aadaan: aadaan-ka: (n) the Muslim call to prayer, It is used to signify the time of prayer for the five obligatory prayers ~ addin.
aadan: (suffix): (v) if you not.... Ex. haddi aadan tagin...; if you don't
aaddan: -aa: (adj) [with preposition ku] 1. aligned (alaynidh); Ex: dheda ku aaddan; aligned in the middle. 2. due (duu); expected or scheduled ~ la filayo. Ex: bishee bay ku aaddan tahay; which month it's due (expected)
aaddi: -yey / say: (n) [with preposition kul align (a laayn); arrange in a line or line up. Ex: safka ku aaddi: keep in line -aad-daanaan -ta: (n) [ with preposition ku] 1. alignment also alignment (a-layn-ment); in parallel lines; opposite (op-pezit) ~ ka soo horjeed. 2. expected ~ la filayo.
aafee: -yey / aafeysay: (v) cause severe damage to something or someone
aafo: -da: (n) disaster (di-saas ter); catastrophe (ka taas taroofi); calamity (kalaamati); an event having fatal or ruinous results ~ masiibo, musiibo
aag: -ga: (n) 1. area (ee-riya); a region. Ex: aagga beeraha; the farming area. Aagga Xamar; the Xamar area. 2. nearby araes ~ u dhaw.
aaga: —aaga: (suffix) (possessive pronoun) with nouns having definite article —ga: ending. your (voor). Ex: buugaaga; your book. Caanahaaga; your milk. Qalinkaaga; your pen
aagaan: -ka: (n) 1. lid or cover used by the nomadic society ~ haruub. 2. small milk container
aakhir: -ka: (n) end (endi); conclusion (kon kuluu shin); completion (kom plit shin); Ex: aakhirka sheekada; the conclusion of the story
aakhirkii: (adv) ultimatly (ool-timeeytli); finally (faay-nali); eventually i•ven juwali) ~ aakhirutaankii.
aakhiro: -da: (n) hereafter (hiyer after); afterlife (after laay); judgement day (jajmant dheey); day of judgement ~ qiyaame
aakhirutaankii: (adv) ultimately (ool-timeeytli); finally (faaynali); eventually (i van juwali) ~ aakhirkii.
aalaa: (adv) often (often); usually (vush wali); regularly or customarily used ~ aalaaba, badanaaba
aalaaba: (adv) mostly (most li); generally (jena rali); usually vush wali) ~ aalaa
aalad: -da (n) instrument (inis tur mant); device (di vaays) ~ qalab
aaladee: -yey / aaladeysay: (v) equip (ikwip); supply with necessary tools aalkolo -aalkolada: (n) alcohol (alkahool) ~ aalkol
aammiin: -ta: (n) amen (ee man); used at the end of a prayer to beg for acceptance
aammin: 1. -ka: (n) trust (tarast); belief (bi-liif); confidence (kon-fi•dansi); faith (feeyth) ~ kalsooni, citiqaad.
2. aammin -ay / tay: (v) trust (tarast); Ex: haddaad aammintid wuu ku khayaamin; if you trust him, he will cheat you

aammin: -ka: (n) 1. trust (tarast); belief (bi-liif); confidence (kon fi dansi); faith (feeyth) kalsooni, citiqaad. 2. aammin -ay /tay: (v) trust (tarast); Ex: haddaad aammintid wuu ku khayaamin; if you trust him, he will cheat you
aammin-ka: (n) time (taaym) wakhti. Ex: waa ammin xun; it is a bad time
aamminaad: -da: (n) 1. trust (tarast); belief (bi-liif). 2. faith (feeyth) ~ citiqaad. 3. credibility (kere-dibiliti); confidence (kon fi dansi)~aamminid, kalsooni
aamminbax: -ay day: (v) [with preposition ka] mistrust (mis tarast); lack of trust or confidence aamminid la'aan, aammindarro. —la aamminikaro: (adj) trustworthy (tarast woor thi); reliable (ri laayabal) lagu kalsoonaan karo. Ex: Cali waa nin la aamminikaro; Ali is a trustworthy person
aammindarro: -da: (n) mistrust (mis tarast); lack of trust or confidence ~ aamminid la'aan, aamminbax. --Syn: uncertainty
aamminsan: -aa: (adj) believing (be lii ving); having a firm faith, confidence, or trust.
aammus: -ay / t ay: (v) shut up (shat ap); silence (saaylans); stop speaking ~ ha hadlin
aammusi: -yey / say: (v) silence (saay lansi); make silent or bring silence to someone or something
aan: aan: (pronoun) 1. me (mii); I (aay); us (aas); we (wii) used the speaking or writing person or persons ~ aannu. Ex: aan wax kuu sheego; let me tell something. 2. (clause pronoun) may I..., can I or let me ~ an. Ex: aan tago; let me go. Buuggaan aan qaato? can I take this book? Biyahaan aan cabbo? may I drink this water?
aan (suffix) I.. to the.. Ex: baankaan aadayaa; I am going to the bank

aan: (adverb) 1. used to express negation; not (nat); im-; in-; un-; il- Ex: aan faraxsanayn; unhappy. 2. suffix: (gadaalgale) -less: without; lacking. Ex: eedla'aan: blameless 3. -ness or -ment suffix: (gadaalgale) state; quality; condition; or degree of nouns derived from adjectives. Ex: aasnaan -ta; the state of being buried
aan daxalaysan: (adj) stainless (isteeyn les); without stain or blemish: Ex: bir aan daxalaysan; stainless steel
aan dhalan: (adj) unborn (an boon). Ex: ilma aan dhalan; an unborn child
aan dhammaanayn: (adj) infinite (infinit); not ending ~ aan xad lahayn
aan dhici karin: (adj) impossible (im poo-sibal) ~ aan suurtagal ahayn, Ex: waa wax aan dici karin in shaqadaan caawa la dhammeeyo; it is impossible to finish this job by tonight
aan islahayn: (adj) matchless (maajles); having no match or equal ~ aan isku habboonayan
aan kala jeclayn: (adj) indifferent (in dif rant)-, having or showing no preference ~ xumaan ama wanaag aan kala jeclayn
aan ku fillayn: (adj) insufficient (insafishanf) ~ naaqis ah. Ex: waxay siisay lacag aan ku fillayn; she gave him insufficient money
aan la dalban: (adj) unsolicited (ansolisitid) not requested ~ aan la wayddiisan
aan la hubin: (adj) uncertain (an ser tan)-, doubtful ~ aan sugnayn, shaki ku jiro
aan la ogolayn: (adj) unacceptable (an-aksep-tibal)-, unauthorized (an oo tha raaysid) ~ aan la fasaxin
aan la sheegin: (adj) 1. unannounced (an-anawn-sid) 2. unspecified (an ispe sifaayid) ~ aan la tilmaamin. Ex: wakhti aan la sheegin; unspecified time
aan la xallin: (adj) unresolved (an ri zoolvidy, unsolved (ansool-vidh) ~ aan weli xal loo helin
aan laga maarmikarin: (adj) indispensable (indispeensabal) ~ daruuri ah, lama huraan ah. Ex: qof aan laga maarmikarin ma jiro; nobody is indispensable. 2. essential (i-seen-shal)
aan lala socon: (adj) 1. unaccompanied (an akam panidh) ~ aan la wehelin. 2. unknown (an-nown)
aan macna lahayn: (adj) meaningless (miiningles); pointless (pooyntles) ~ aan wax ka soo qaad lahayn.
aan macquul ahayn: (adj) unreasonable {an rii sanabal)-, irrational (i raa shinaal) ~ aan caqli ahayn
aan milmayn: (adj) insoluble (in sol yabal), that which cannot be dissolved ~ aan qasmayn
aan muhiimad lahayn: (adj) insignificant (insignifikant)-, trivial (tirivaal); lacking in importance; unimportant ~ aan qiima lahayn
aan muran lahayn: (adj) indisputable (in dis biyuu tibal), ~ aan laysku khilaafi karin, xaqiiq ah
aan muuqan: (adj) hidden (hidhen)-, invisible (inviizibal); unseen (ansiin) ~ aan la arkayn
aan qaybsamin: (adj) indivisible (in di vi sabaV) ~ lakala qaybin karin
aan qiimo lahayn: (adj) 1. worthless (weerthlis)-, of no use or value ~ aan macna lahayn 2. cheap (jiip)
aan rasmi ahayn: (adj) informal (infoormal); unofficial (an o-fishaly, casual (kaashuwal) ~ aan caadi ahayn. Ex: shir aan rasmi ahayn; an informal meeting
aan sinnayn: (adj) uneven (an ii-van); rough (raf); unequal (an-ikwal) ~ aan isle'ekayn
aan waxbaran: (adj) uneducated (anejukeeytidh), ignorant (ig no rant) ~ see also [eeg] jaahil ah
aan xadaysnayn: (adj) unlimited (anlimitidh), indefinite (indhefanif) ~ aan caddayn, aan xadaysnayn. Ex: waxay maqnaan doontaa waqti aan xadaysnayn; she will be away for an indefinite period of time
aan xal lahayn: (adj) insoluble (insolyabal) impossible to solve; having no solution ~ aan la xallin karin. Ex: dhibaato aan xal lahayn; an insolvable problem. Ex: arrin aan xal lahayn; insoluble matter
aan xaq ahayn: (adj) 1. unjust (an-jast); not just; 2. unfair (anfeer) ~ aan caddaalad ahayn.
aanee: -yey / aaneysay: (v) [ with preposition u ] hold liable to; desire revenge; to spite; accuse (akiyuus)
aannan: (pronoun) not; we or I if ... not. Ex: haddii aannan imaan, iska tag; if I didn 't come, go. Ex: haddii annaan shaqaynin, lacag nala siin mayo; ifwe didn't work, we will not be paid.
aannu: (pronoun) let....us. Ex: Aannu u sheegno; let us tell him. Na keen aannu cashaynee; come on, let us have a dinner
aano: -aanada: (n) resentment (ri zent ment)-, anger (an ger)-, grievance aroused by something unjust, mean, or unworthy ~ godob, dakano
-aansho: (suffix)-. —ation: the result of an action or process. Ex: madoobaansho; the state of being black; dheeraansho; the state of being tall or long

aardoon: -ka: (n) revenger (ri-veenjer); one who is seeking to take vengeance (ven-jansi)
aargalaan: -ka: (n) a large metal cup for drinking ~ kalax
aargudo: -aargutay / aargudatay: (v) seek or take vengeance for yourself; avenge (a-veeji); revenge (ri-veeji)
-u aargud: -ay / day: (v) seek or take vengeance for another person; avenge (aveenji) ~u aar
aariyee: -yey / say: (v) inflate (infaleeyt); fill something with air or gas
aarso: -aarsay I aarsatay: (v) revenge (ri veenji); avenge (aveenji); retaliate (ri-taali-yeeyt) seek or take vengeance for [oneself or another person]
aartilari: -ga: (n) artillery (aar tarleri); large-caliber weapons, such as cannon, howitzers, and missile launchers ~ sida madfac, kanooni ama hawser.
aaryo qaadasho: -qaadashada: (n) outing (aaw-ting); excursion (ikis-keer-shiri); a walk outdoors ~ aariyo qaadasho
aas: -ka: (n) 1. the act or process of burying; burial (beeriyal); funeral (fiyuunaral) ~ duug, xabaal
—aas -ay / tay: (v) 2. place in the ground; bury (beeri) ~ duug, xabaal
3. aas-ku: (n) sunset (san-set). Ex: aasku intuuna madoobaan; before the sunset [before it gets dark]
aasaas: -ka: (n) foundation (fawn-dheey-shin); base, basis, ground, groundwork ~ sal, bilow —aasaas -ay / tay: (v) establish (is taab-liish); set up; found
aasaasi: -ga: (n) 1. essential (i-sen-shel); fundamental (fan-dha-men-tai). 2. inherence or indispensable ~ lama huraan
aasan: -aa: (adj) buried (beeridh); placed in the ground ~ xabaalan ama duugan
aasbiriin: -ka: (n) aspirin (aas-periin). Ex: keniin aasbariin ah; an aspirin tablet

aasnaan: -ta: (n) a condition or state of being buried
-aato: (suffix)-, if she... Ex: hadday jeclaato; if she likes; hadday fiicnaato; ifshe gets better
aawaday: (preposition) for my sake ~ dartay. Ex: waxay u joogeen aawaday; they stayed for my sake
aawadeed: (preposition) for it's or her sake ~ darteed, awgeed
aawadiis: (preposition) 1. for his sake ~ dartiis, awgiis 2. because of
aaway?: [aawey] (adv) where? (weer); at or in what place?. Ex: Aaway taleefoonkii? where is the telephone?
aawaye?: (adv) [aaweye] where are they? ~ meeye. Ex: Carruurtii aawaye? where are the children?
aay: -ey / day: (v) [with preposition u] benefit (bene fit)-, derive advantage from something at later time
aayad: -da: (n) koranic verse; an individual verse in the Quran
aayar: (adv) slowly (islowli); taking more time than is usual or necessary ~ tartiib, qunyar. Ex: Aayar u soco; walk slowly. —Syn: dilatory, leisurely, laggard, deliberate

aaye: -aayaha: (n) fate (feyt); predetermined events ~ see also [eeg] aayatiin
aayo: -aayaha: (n) fate (feyt); predetermined events ~ see also [eeg] aayatiin
aayo: aayada: (n) 1. stepmother (isteep maadar); the wife of one's father or uncle. 2. aunt (aanti); the sister of one's father ~ eeddo. 3. u aayo: benefit (bene fit) ~ see also [eeg] u aay
ab: -ka: (n) forefather (foorfaathar); ancestor (aan ses ter) ~ isir, walcan, sullan
abaabul: -ka: (n) 1. organization (oorgenizeeyshin). 2 -abaabulka: (adj) organizational. Ex: guddiga abaabulka; organizational committee. 3. —abaabul -ay /
abaad: -ay I day: (v) lost (loosti); no longer in the possession for a long time ~ abaaji. Ex: xoolihii abaaday; the lost livestock
abaahi: -yey: (v) mate (meeyt); pair animals [especially camels] for breeding ~ u hay, kud
abaaji: -yey / say: (v) lost (loosti); no longer in the possession for a long time ~ abaad

abaaldaran: (adj) ungrateful (an.gareeyt.ful); not feeling or exhibiting gratitude, thanks, or appreciation ~ abaallaawe, asxaanlaawe
abaaldarro: -abaaldarrada: (n) ungratefulness (an-gareeyt-fuul-nes); lack of gratitude, lack of appreciation ~ abaal ka dhac

abaalmarin: -ta: (n) reward (ri woordh) ~ abaalgud, jaa'isad, jiso, mutaysi. -Syn: award (a woordh); promotion (pare mow shen); prize (pareyz); recompense (re kom pensi) -abaalmari -yey/say: (v) reward (ri-woordh); award (a woordh)

ababi: -yey -say: (v) raise (reeyz); bring up; rear (riyar) ~ barbaari. Ex: waxaa nalaku ababshay diinta Islaamka; we were raised in the Islamic religion.

abaydin: -ka: (n) a young mammal that has been abandoned by it's mother; weaned (wiinid)
abbaanduule: -abbaanduulaha: (n) commander (ka maan dher); Commander in Chief ~ ammaan-duule
abbaar: abbaar-ta: (adv) 1. supposed (se pow.sidh); intended (in teendid); Ex: abbaartiisu maxay ahayd...; what he was supposed to do. 2. right approach

abbaaro: -abbaaraha: (adv) about (a bowt); approximately; nearly: Ex: abbaaraha wuu tagay; he is almost there

abboowe: -abboowaha: (n) 1. brother (baraather) ~ boowe, walaal. 2. dear (diyar); the boy or man that is greatly loved ~ gacaliye
abeer: -ka: (n) heifer (he far); a young camel, especially one that has not yet given birth ~ qaalin, ameer
abhi: -yey / say: (v) warn (woon); caution (kooshin); forewarn (foor-woon) ~ u dig
abid: (adv) [ with possessive pronoun] 1. never (nevar); eternity ~ waligeed. Ex: abidkay ma arag; 1 never saw him. 2. ever (ever); at any time: Ex: abidkaa ma cuntay? have you ever eaten?

abraar: -ay / tay: (v) stampede (staampiidh); cause for example a herd of animals to flee in panic and over run something or someone ~ didmo

abti: -ga: (n) uncle (ankal); the brother of one's mother
abtirsiinyo: -abtirsiinyaha: (n) genealogy (jiniyoolaji); lineage (liineeyj) ~ family tree; pedigree (pedigrii) ~ abtris, tafiir, abtirsi
abukaate: -abukaataha: (n) lawyer (looyar)-, attorney (atooni)-, counselor (konsular); counsel, barrister, solicitor ~ qareen.
